exercises.stem: 选择正确的选项完成句子：When I saw Anna yesterday, she said she ________ her aunt the next day.

choices.label: A
choices.text: would visit

choices.label: B
choices.text: will visit

choices.label: C
choices.text: was visiting

choices.label: D
choices.text: visited

exercises.explanation: said发生在过去，而visit发生在said之后，表示从过去某一时间看将要发生的动作，应使用过去将来时。其常用结构是would+动词原形，因此选would visit。

keypoints.title: 现在进行时的含义
keypoints.body: 现在进行时表示说话时正在进行的动作，也可表示现阶段持续进行的活动或按计划近期发生的动作。

keypoints.title: 现在进行时的结构
keypoints.body: 肯定句用“主语+am/is/are+动词-ing形式”。I用am，单数第三人称用is，you及复数主语用are；否定句在其后加not。

exercises.stem:
根据语境选择正确的选项完成对话：
—Where is Lily?
—She is in her room. She ___ a letter to her friend now.

choices.label: A
choices.text: writes

choices.label: B
choices.text: is writing

choices.label: C
choices.text: wrote

choices.label: D
choices.text: has written

exercises.explanation: 句中的 now 表示动作正在说话时进行，应使用现在进行时。主语 She 是单数第三人称，be 动词用 is，write 变为 writing，因此选 is writing。

keypoints.title: 表示过去与现在的联系
keypoints.body: 现在完成时表示过去发生但与现在有联系的动作或状态，也可表示截至现在的经历、已完成的事情，或从过去持续到现在的情况。基本形式是 have/has＋过去分词。

keypoints.title: 避免搭配明确过去时间
keypoints.body: 现在完成时通常不与 yesterday、last week、in 2020 等已结束的明确过去时间连用；have/has 后必须用过去分词，不能用动词原形或一般过去式。

exercises.stem: 下列句子中，使用现在完成时且能表示“截至现在的经历”的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: I have seen that film three times.

choices.label: B
choices.text: I have saw that film three times.

choices.label: C
choices.text: I have seen that film yesterday.

choices.label: D
choices.text: I saw that film three times.

exercises.explanation: A 使用 have＋过去分词 seen，表示截至现在看过这部电影三次的经历。B 中 have 后误用了过去式 saw；C 将现在完成时与已结束的明确过去时间 yesterday 连用，通常不正确；D 是一般过去时，不是现在完成时。

keypoints.title: 表示将来的动作或状态
keypoints.body: 一般将来时表示将来某个时间发生的动作或存在的状态。常用 will＋动词原形；be going to＋动词原形也可表示按计划或根据迹象将要发生的事情。

keypoints.title: 掌握句型变化
keypoints.body: 肯定句用 will＋动词原形；否定句在 will 后加 not；一般疑问句把 will 提到主语前。主语改变时，will 的形式不变。

exercises.stem:
请用 will 的正确形式完成对话，每空填一个词：
—____ you ____ (visit) your grandparents this weekend?
—Yes, I ____.
exercises.explanation: 一般将来时可用 will＋动词原形。一般疑问句要把 will 提到主语 you 前，构成 Will you visit；肯定回答用 Yes, I will。will 不随主语改变形式，visit 使用原形。

keypoints.title: 表示过去的动作状态
keypoints.body: 一般过去时表示过去某个时间发生的动作、存在的状态或过去经常性的行为，重点说明过去的情况。常与表示过去时间的词语连用。

keypoints.title: 过去式与 did 的用法
keypoints.body: 肯定句谓语用动词过去式；否定句和一般疑问句通常借助 did，此时实义动词用原形，如 did not go、Did you go? be 动词用 was/were，不与 did 同用。

exercises.stem: 用括号内动词的适当形式填空。Yesterday, Kate ___ (visit) the museum. She ___ not ___ (buy) a postcard because it was expensive. ___ she ___ (enjoy) the trip?
exercises.explanation: Yesterday 表示过去时间，肯定句用 visit 的过去式 visited。否定句和一般疑问句借助 did，此时实义动词用原形，因此是 did not buy 和 Did she enjoy。

keypoints.title: 表示经常或客观事实
keypoints.body: 一般现在时表示经常性、习惯性或反复发生的动作，也表示现在的状态、客观事实和普遍规律。

keypoints.title: 注意主谓形式变化
keypoints.body: 主语为第三人称单数时，实义动词通常加 -s 或 -es；其他主语用动词原形。否定句和疑问句通常用 do/does，does 后的实义动词用原形。

exercises.stem: 选择能正确完成对话的一项。\n—___ your brother ___ basketball every Saturday?\n—Yes, he ___.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Does；play；does

choices.label: B
choices.text: Do；plays；does

choices.label: C
choices.text: Does；plays；do

choices.label: D
choices.text: Do；play；do

exercises.explanation: your brother 是第三人称单数，一般疑问句用 Does，does 后的实义动词用原形 play；肯定回答用 Yes, he does。

keypoints.title: 时态呼应是什么
keypoints.body: 时态的一致与呼应是指同一语境中，各分句的时态既符合动作发生的时间，也根据主从句的时间关系相互协调。主句为过去时，宾语从句常相应后移，但客观事实、普遍真理通常仍用一般现在时。

keypoints.title: 判断时态的步骤
keypoints.body: 先确定各动作的参照时间，再判断同时、先后或将来关系；若主句为过去时，分别常用一般过去时、过去完成时和过去将来时表达同时、先于和后于主句的动作，最后结合语境检查是否需要保留一般现在时。

exercises.stem: 根据时态呼应规则，选择最恰当的一项。“太阳从东方升起”是客观事实；参观活动发生在老师说话之后。\nYesterday, the teacher said that the sun ___ in the east and that we ___ the science museum the next day.

choices.label: A
choices.text: rises；would visit

choices.label: B
choices.text: rose；will visit

choices.label: C
choices.text: rises；will visit

choices.label: D
choices.text: rose；would visit

exercises.explanation: 主句 said 为过去时。客观事实“太阳从东方升起”通常仍用一般现在时 rises；参观发生在 said 之后，属于过去将来，用 would visit。因此选 A。

keypoints.title: 主动与被动的区别
keypoints.body: 主动语态中，主语是动作的执行者；被动语态中，主语是动作的承受者。两者在意义基本不变时可以转换：主动句宾语变为被动句主语，原主语可置于by后。

keypoints.title: 语态转换的步骤
keypoints.body: 转换时先找主动句的主语、谓语和宾语；把宾语置于句首，按原时态和主语数将谓语改为be＋过去分词，再把原主语置于by后；执行者不重要或不清楚时可省略。只有及物动词通常能直接转换。

exercises.stem: 将句子改为被动语态，保持原意：The nurse checks the patients every morning.
exercises.answer: The patients are checked by the nurse every morning.
exercises.explanation: 主动句的宾语the patients变为被动句主语；一般现在时的被动结构用are＋过去分词checked；原主语the nurse置于by后。

keypoints.title: 被动语态的构成
keypoints.body: 被动语态以动作承受者为主语，核心结构是be动词加及物动词的过去分词；动作执行者需要强调时用by短语表示，不需要说明时可以省略。

keypoints.title: 被动结构的基本公式
keypoints.body: 基本式：主语＋be＋过去分词（＋by＋执行者）。be随时态、人称和数变化：进行时用being，完成时用been；情态动词后用be＋过去分词。

exercises.stem: 下列句子中，被动语态结构正确的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: The door must be closed before 9 p.m.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The door must closed before 9 p.m.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The door must be close before 9 p.m.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The door must is closed before 9 p.m.

exercises.explanation: 情态动词后面的被动语态结构是“情态动词＋be＋过去分词”。因此应为must be closed。B缺少be，C把过去分词closed误写为原形或错误形式，D在must后错误使用is。

keypoints.title: 一般过去时被动
keypoints.body: 一般过去时的被动语态表示过去某时发生且已完成的动作或事件，主语是动作承受者，执行者可由by短语说明或省略。

keypoints.title: 一般过去时被动公式
keypoints.body: 肯定句：主语＋was/were＋过去分词（＋by＋执行者）。was用于单数主语，were用于复数主语及you；否定在was/were后加not，疑问将was/were提至句首。

keypoints.title: 别把过去分词写错
keypoints.body: be后必须用过去分词，不能用动词原形或一般过去式；否定、疑问仍以was/were构成，不要另加did。例如“被发现”应为was/were found，而不是was/were find或did be found。

exercises.stem: 选择能正确表达“这些窗户昨天被清洁了”的句子。

choices.label: A
choices.text: The windows was cleaned yesterday.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The windows were cleaned yesterday.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The windows were clean yesterday.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The windows did be cleaned yesterday.

exercises.explanation: 一般过去时的被动结构是“主语＋was/were＋过去分词”。The windows是复数，应用were；clean的过去分词是cleaned，所以正确答案是B。被动语态的否定或疑问也不使用did。

keypoints.title: 表示经常发生的被动动作
keypoints.body: 一般现在时的被动语态表示主语是动作的承受者，常用于描述经常发生的动作、客观事实、规章制度等。

keypoints.title: 基本结构是be加过去分词
keypoints.body: 基本结构为“主语＋am/is/are＋及物动词的过去分词”。be随主语的人称和数变化，否定句在be后加not，一般疑问句将be提至句首。

exercises.stem: 下列句子中，能正确表达“这间教室每天都被学生打扫”的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: The classroom cleans by students every day.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The classroom is cleaned by students every day.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The classroom is cleaning by students every day.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The classroom cleaned by students every day.

exercises.explanation: “这间教室”是动作的承受者，应用被动语态；表示经常发生的动作，用一般现在时。主语the classroom为单数，因此be动词用is，clean的过去分词为cleaned，结构是is cleaned。

keypoints.title: 语调传递态度和意图
keypoints.body: 语调表达的态度与意图，是说话时音高、语势等变化在语境中的表意作用。同一句话使用不同语调，可能表达陈述、疑问、惊讶、怀疑、礼貌或不满等。

keypoints.title: 结合语境判断语调含义
keypoints.body: 理解语调时，要同时关注说话内容、重音、意群和音高变化，并结合说话人的身份、语境及上下文判断其真实态度和意图，不能只凭一个音调下结论。

exercises.stem: John告诉同学：“I won the speech contest.” Mary听到这个出乎意料的消息后，停顿了一下，用明显上扬的语调说：“You won the speech contest?” Mary最可能表达的态度和意图是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: 感到惊讶，并请求对方确认这个消息

choices.label: B
choices.text: 十分确定地陈述一个已经知道的事实

choices.label: C
choices.text: 因为对方迟到而表达强烈不满

choices.label: D
choices.text: 礼貌地邀请对方参加演讲比赛

exercises.explanation: 这里的内容是对John刚说消息的重复，且语境说明消息出乎意料；明显上扬的语调使它成为带有惊讶意味的回声疑问句，Mary是在请求确认，而不是普通陈述。理解语调需要结合内容和上下文，不能只看音高变化。

keypoints.title: 相邻词语自然衔接发音
keypoints.body: 连读是连续说话时，前一个词词尾的音与后一个词词首的音自然衔接，使词语之间少停顿、语流更连贯。常见情形是前词以辅音结尾、后词以元音开头。

keypoints.title: 按意群练习连贯语流
keypoints.body: 朗读时先划分意群，再将词尾辅音自然带向下一个词的词首元音；练习应先慢后快，保持节奏连贯，不要为了连读改变单词的基本发音。

exercises.stem: 朗读句子“Turn off the light.”时，关于连读的正确做法是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: 将turn词尾的辅音自然带向off词首的元音，词间少停顿，同时不改变两个单词的基本发音

choices.label: B
choices.text: 在turn和off之间完全停顿，以清楚保持两个单词的边界

choices.label: C
choices.text: 把off词首的元音改成辅音，才能和turn连读

choices.label: D
choices.text: 只有当前一个词和后一个词都以元音结尾时，两个词才能连读

exercises.explanation: turn以辅音/n/结尾，off以元音开头，连续朗读时可把/n/自然衔接到后面的元音，减少词间停顿，使语流更连贯。连读不等于改变单词的基本发音。

keypoints.title: 音高向上或向下变化
keypoints.body: 升调与降调是语句或意群结尾处音高的主要变化方式。升调指音高向上移动，降调指音高向下移动，它们能帮助听者判断语句的语气和是否完整。

keypoints.title: 升降调的常见语用功能
keypoints.body: 降调常见于完整陈述、特殊疑问和明确指令；升调常见于一般疑问、确认、未说完或需要对方回应的表达。具体含义还要结合语境、重音和说话人的态度判断。

exercises.stem: 在通常、没有特别强调的语境中，下面哪一项的句末语调与语用功能搭配正确？

choices.label: A
choices.text: “Are you coming with us?” 用降调，因为它是完整问句。

choices.label: B
choices.text: “Where is my pen?” 用升调，因为说话人等待回答。

choices.label: C
choices.text: “I finished my homework.” 用降调，因为这是完整陈述。

choices.label: D
choices.text: “Open the door, please.” 用升调，因为祈使句通常表示未说完。

exercises.explanation: 完整陈述句通常在句末使用降调，表示意思基本完整。一般疑问句通常用升调；特殊疑问句和明确指令通常用降调，因此A、B、D不当。

keypoints.title: 弱读与失去爆破
keypoints.body: 弱读是句中某些功能词或非重读音节用较轻、较短的形式发音，常伴随元音弱化；失去爆破是爆破音在特定相邻音影响下只形成阻塞、不释放明显爆破声。二者都不等于完全省略音。

keypoints.title: 辨听与朗读
keypoints.body: 先找句子重音和意群：非重读的常用功能词可采用弱读；/p/、/b/、/t/、/d/、/k/、/g/在另一个辅音前，尤其是另一个爆破音前，可保留阻塞并减弱或不释放爆破。朗读时不可处处弱读。

exercises.stem: 在中性语境中朗读句子“The black bag is on the desk.”，下列说法最恰当的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: 句首的the通常要重读并读得很长，black末尾的/k/在/b/前必须有明显爆破。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 句首的the可以弱读为/ðə/；black末尾的/k/在/b/前可以只保持阻塞而不明显释放，但不能把/k/完全删掉。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 句首的the和on都必须完全不发音，/k/要直接变成/b/。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 句中所有词都应弱读，失去爆破就是把有关辅音音素省略。

exercises.explanation: 在中性朗读中，功能词the通常不重读，可弱读为/ðə/。black中的/k/后面紧接爆破音/b/，发音时可以形成阻塞而减弱或不释放明显爆破声，但/k/仍然存在，不能当作完全省略。

keypoints.title: 辅音音素的含义
keypoints.body: 辅音音素是发音时气流在口腔或声门处受到阻碍或形成狭窄，并能区别词义的最小语音单位，如 /p/、/m/、/ʃ/。

keypoints.title: 辅音的分类依据
keypoints.body: 辅音音素可按发音部位、发音方式和声带是否振动分类。读音相近的辅音，如 /p/ 与 /b/，应同时关注阻碍位置、气流方式和声带状态。

exercises.stem: 关于英语辅音音素/p/和/b/，下列说法正确的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: 二者发音部位不同，但发音方式相同，且都不振动声带。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 二者都在双唇处形成阻碍，都是爆破音；/p/通常为清音，/b/通常为浊音，因此pig和big的词义可因首音不同而不同。

choices.label: C
choices.text: /p/和/b/都属于元音，因为发音时气流没有阻碍。

choices.label: D
choices.text: /p/与/b/只能靠拼写区分，口语中不会造成词义差别。

exercises.explanation: /p/和/b/的发音部位都是双唇，发音方式都是爆破；主要区别在于声带状态，/p/通常不振动声带，/b/通常振动声带。首音的不同可以区别pig和big的词义。

keypoints.title: 查词典确认读音
keypoints.body: 查词典获取读音，是借助词典中的音标、重音标记、音频或发音说明，确认单词的音素组合、重音和必要的发音变体，而不是只根据拼写猜读音。

keypoints.title: 查读音的步骤
keypoints.body: 定位单词后，先核对词性和词义，再查看音标、音节划分与重音标记，比较英式或美式发音并试听音频；记录音标和重读位置，最后按音标跟读核验。

exercises.stem: 小明在句子“Please record the song.”中不会读单词 record。词典显示：record n. /ˈrekɔːd/（录音；唱片）；record v. /rɪˈkɔːd/（录制）。他应采用哪种查词典方法？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 先根据句意确认 record 在句中作动词，再查看 v. 后的音标和重音，读作 /rɪˈkɔːd/，必要时试听相应音频。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 不看词性，直接选择第一个音标 /ˈrekɔːd/，因为同一个拼写只能有一种读音。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 只根据字母拼写把 record 读出来，不必查看音标或重音标记。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 选择名词的音标 /ˈrekɔːd/，因为 song 是名词，所以 record 也应读名词音。

exercises.explanation: 句中“Please record the song”表示“请录制这首歌”，record 在此作动词，应查词典中的 v. 项。该项音标为 /rɪˈkɔːd/，重音在第二个音节。查读音时要先核对词性和词义，再查看音标、重音并可结合音频确认，不能只凭拼写猜读音。

keypoints.title: 音标拼读的含义
keypoints.body: 根据音标拼读单词，是把音标按音节依次转成对应音素，再依据音节、重音等信息合成为完整单词读音的过程。

keypoints.title: 音标拼读步骤
keypoints.body: 先识别音标和音节界线，标出重音；逐个读准元音和辅音，再由慢到快拼合，重读音节读得更突出，最后结合词典音频检查。遇到不熟悉的符号，不要用字母名称替代其音值。

exercises.stem: 音标 /ˈkɪtʃɪn/ 对应下面哪个单词？拼读时应注意音标中的重音标记。

choices.label: A
choices.text: kitchen

choices.label: B
choices.text: chicken

choices.label: C
choices.text: kitten

choices.label: D
choices.text: teacher

exercises.explanation: /ˈkɪtʃɪn/ 可按音节拼读为 /kɪt/ 和 /tʃɪn/，合起来是 kitchen；符号 /ˈ/ 表示第一个音节重读。chicken 的开头是 /tʃ/，kitten 中间通常是 /t/，teacher 的音标结构也不同。

keypoints.title: IPA是什么
keypoints.body: 国际音标（IPA）是一套用统一符号记录人类语音的标音系统。英语词典中的音标用符号表示单词的读音，帮助学习者准确辨认和拼读单词。

keypoints.title: 按音标拼读单词
keypoints.body: 先辨认音标符号及其音值，再按音节、重音和音标顺序拼读；查词典时注意长音、双元音、重音和词尾音，并结合示范音检查读音。

exercises.stem: 观察音标 /ˈteɪbəl/，下列说法正确的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: /ˈ/ 位于第一个音节前，表示第一个音节重读；/eɪ/ 是双元音，整个音标可拼读为 table。

choices.label: B
choices.text: /ˈ/ 表示第一个音节要读成长音，/eɪ/ 只需读字母 e 的名称。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 因为音标中有 /ə/，所以第二个音节应重读，并把 /ə/ 读成字母 a 的名称。

choices.label: D
choices.text: /b/ 表示字母 b 的名称“bee”，拼读时应把它单独读成 /biː/。

exercises.explanation: 音标 /ˈteɪbəl/ 分为两个音节：/teɪ/ 和 /bəl/。重音符号 /ˈ/ 放在重读音节前，说明第一个音节重读；/eɪ/ 是双元音，/ə/ 是非重读音节中的元音音素，不能按字母名称替代。按音标顺序拼读可得到 table。

keypoints.title: 元音音素是什么
keypoints.body: 元音音素是发音时气流通过口腔基本不受阻碍、能充当音节核心的语音单位。英语元音可按发音过程分为单元音和双元音。

keypoints.title: 元音的主要特征
keypoints.body: 元音的音质主要由舌位、舌高和唇形等决定，部分元音还因长短不同而区别词义。辨认元音时不能只看拼写，要结合音标判断实际读音。

exercises.stem: 下列单词的实际发音与所给元音音素对应正确的是？（按常见英式读音判断。）

choices.label: A
choices.text: map /mæp/：元音音素是 /æ/

choices.label: B
choices.text: see /siː/：元音音素是 /ɪ/

choices.label: C
choices.text: book /bʊk/：元音音素是 /uː/

choices.label: D
choices.text: home /həʊm/：元音音素是 /ɒ/

exercises.explanation: map的元音音素为/æ/，发音时气流通过口腔基本不受阻碍，/æ/属于元音音素。see的元音是/iː/，book的元音是/ʊ/，home的元音是/əʊ/。判断元音音素应依据音标和实际读音，不能只看字母拼写。

keypoints.title: 英语节奏是什么
keypoints.body: 英语节奏是语流中重读音节与非重读音节按照一定的强弱、长短和间隔交替组织形成的韵律模式。

keypoints.title: 朗读中体现节奏
keypoints.body: 朗读时先确定句中重读词，再突出重读音节；非重读词适当弱读、缩短，重读音节之间保持自然均衡，并根据表达重点调整节奏。

exercises.stem: 在没有特殊强调的情况下，朗读句子“We will meet at the station tomorrow.”时，大写部分表示重读，哪一种节奏处理最恰当？

choices.label: A
choices.text: WE WILL MEET AT THE STATION TOMORROW.

choices.label: B
choices.text: we will MEET at the STATION toMORrow.

choices.label: C
choices.text: WE will meet AT the station TOMORROW.

choices.label: D
choices.text: we WILL meet at THE station tomorrow.

exercises.explanation: 在中性语境中，实义动词meet、名词station和时间副词tomorrow通常是主要重读词；we、will、at、the等功能词通常弱读或轻读。B能突出主要重读音节，并使重读与非重读音节形成自然的强弱、长短节奏。

keypoints.title: 意群是什么
keypoints.body: 意群（sense group）是按照意义和语法关系组成的、在语流中作为相对完整单位的词组或分句，通常通过短暂停顿和语调边界体现。

keypoints.title: 划分意群的方法
keypoints.body: 先理解句意并找出紧密相连的词组，再按意义层次划分，在意群之间用“/”标记。组内连贯朗读，边界处短暂停顿，避免拆开关系紧密的成分。

exercises.stem: 给句子划分意群时，应在意群之间用“/”表示短暂停顿。下列划分最恰当的是：After the rain stopped, the children went outside to play.

choices.label: A
choices.text: After / the rain stopped / the children went outside / to play.

choices.label: B
choices.text: After the rain / stopped the children / went outside to play.

choices.label: C
choices.text: After the rain stopped / the children went outside to play.

choices.label: D
choices.text: After the rain stopped the children / went outside / to play.

exercises.explanation: “After the rain stopped”是表示时间的从句，“the children went outside to play”是主句，二者意义和语法关系相对完整，适合在从句与主句之间短暂停顿。不能把紧密相连的“After”与其从句拆开，也不宜拆开“to play”等紧密成分。

keypoints.title: 句子重音是什么
keypoints.body: 句子重音是说话时使句中某些词比其他词更突出的一种语音现象，通常通过音量较大、时长较长、音高变化明显和元音发音清晰等方式表现。

keypoints.title: 判断句子重音
keypoints.body: 理解或朗读时，先找出句中的新信息、关键信息或对比信息，这些词通常需要重读；实词一般比虚词更容易重读，但为突出特定意义，重音位置可以改变。

exercises.stem: 阅读对话：A: Did Mike borrow the green dictionary? B: No. He borrowed the blue dictionary. 在B的回答中，哪个词最可能承担句子的主要重音？

choices.label: A
choices.text: He

choices.label: B
choices.text: borrowed

choices.label: C
choices.text: blue

choices.label: D
choices.text: dictionary

exercises.explanation: blue与上文的green形成对比，也是回答中的关键信息，因此通常需要重读。He是代词，borrowed和dictionary在语境中已有或可预期，通常不承担主要重音。

keypoints.title: 单词重音是什么
keypoints.body: 单词重音是多音节英语单词中某一个音节比其他音节更突出的发音现象。重读音节通常音量较大、时长较长、音高较明显，元音也更清晰。

keypoints.title: 单词重音的作用
keypoints.body: 单词重音通常属于单词读音的一部分，位置错误会影响听者辨认和理解；有些词重音位置变化还可能造成词性或意义的变化，不能只凭字母拼写判断。

exercises.stem: 下列哪一项正确表示单词 important 的重音位置？（大写音节表示重读。）

choices.label: A
choices.text: IM-por-tant

choices.label: B
choices.text: im-POR-tant

choices.label: C
choices.text: im-por-TANT

choices.label: D
choices.text: IM-POR-tant

exercises.explanation: important有三个音节，重音落在第二个音节por上，读作 im-POR-tant。重读音节通常更响、更长、音高变化更明显，元音也更清晰。

keypoints.title: 同意与拒绝是什么
keypoints.body: 同意是接受或赞成他人的请求、建议、观点或安排；拒绝是不接受或不能接受，并清楚表达自己的立场。二者都要结合交际目的、场合和双方关系选择恰当的表达方式。

keypoints.title: 得体表达同意拒绝
keypoints.body: 表达同意可直接说明赞成并补充具体安排；表达拒绝时，可先表示理解或感谢，再说明真实、简洁的原因，必要时提出替代方案，避免生硬或含糊。

exercises.stem: 你的同学邀请你参加本周六的公园清洁活动，但你当天已经有家庭安排。下面哪种回答最得体？

choices.label: A
choices.text: No, I won't.

choices.label: B
choices.text: I'm busy.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Thanks for inviting me, but I have a family appointment that day. Could I join you next time?

choices.label: D
choices.text: Yes, I can.

exercises.explanation: C先感谢对方的邀请，再简洁说明不能参加的原因，并提出下次参加的可能，体现了礼貌、清楚而得体的拒绝。A语气生硬，B信息不够完整，D与已知情况不符。

keypoints.title: 道歉与致谢是什么
keypoints.body: 道歉是因自己的过失、打扰或造成不便而表达歉意，并承担相应责任；致谢是因他人的帮助、善意或付出而表达感激。二者都属于根据情境作出的礼貌交际行为。

keypoints.title: 得体表达道歉致谢
keypoints.body: 道歉时可说明歉意、简要解释情况并提出改正或补救；致谢时应明确感谢对象和原因。根据场合及关系选择正式或非正式的表达，避免敷衍或过度。

exercises.stem: 你不小心把同学的作业本弄湿了，而且同学之前还帮你保留了座位。下列哪句话最得体，能同时表达道歉和致谢？

choices.label: A
choices.text: I'm sorry I got your notebook wet. Thank you for saving me a seat. I'll help you rewrite the notes.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Thank you for getting my notebook wet. You should say sorry.

choices.label: C
choices.text: I'm sorry you saved me a seat. Never mind the notebook.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Give me your notebook. I need it now.

exercises.explanation: A 中“I'm sorry...”说明因自己的过失道歉，“Thank you...”明确感谢同学帮忙保留座位，并提出“帮忙重写笔记”作为补救措施，符合得体交际的要求。其他选项混淆了道歉和致谢，或语气不礼貌。

keypoints.title: 功能与范围
keypoints.body: “询问与告知”是围绕人、事、物、时间、地点、原因等获取或提供信息的交际功能。询问重在明确所需信息，告知重在准确传递事实、情况或安排。

keypoints.title: 选择恰当表达
keypoints.body: 先根据对象和场合选择直接或委婉的问法；询问后确认关键信息，告知时交代必要细节并确认对方理解。正式场合可使用更礼貌、完整的表达。

exercises.stem: 在学校前台，你想询问英语社团的活动地点和时间。以下哪组对话最恰当、信息最完整？

choices.label: A
choices.text: Student: Excuse me, could you tell me where and when the English Club meets? Staff: It meets in Room 203 at 4:30 p.m. on Friday.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Student: English Club? Staff: Yes, I like English.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Student: Tell me the room now. Staff: It may be good.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Student: When is Room 203? Staff: The club is a room.

exercises.explanation: A 使用“Excuse me, could you tell me...?”礼貌地询问，并准确告知了活动地点、时间和日期，信息完整。B、C、D 要么没有明确询问和回答，要么表达不合乎英语习惯。

keypoints.title: 情感表达的含义
keypoints.body: 表达情感是用语言表达自己或理解他人的喜、怒、哀、乐、惊讶、担忧、感谢、遗憾等情绪和情感态度的交际功能。

keypoints.title: 表达情感的方法
keypoints.body: 先判断情感的类型和强度，再选择合适的词语、语气和表达方式。表达负面情感时要顾及对方感受，必要时使用较委婉的说法。

exercises.stem: 你的朋友在歌唱比赛中获得第一名，你想表达高兴和祝贺。下列哪句话最恰当？

choices.label: A
choices.text: Congratulations! I'm really happy for you. You sang wonderfully!

choices.label: B
choices.text: Why did you win? I don't want to hear about it.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Please tell me where the library is.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Give me your prize.

exercises.explanation: A 中“Congratulations!”表达祝贺，“I'm really happy for you”表达为朋友高兴，“You sang wonderfully!”进一步肯定朋友的表现，情感积极且语气自然。其余选项没有恰当地表达喜悦或祝贺。

keypoints.title: 观点态度的含义
keypoints.body: 表达观点与态度是就人、事或问题提出自己的看法，并表明赞同、反对、肯定、怀疑等立场或态度的交际功能。

keypoints.title: 清楚表达立场
keypoints.body: 表达时可先说明观点，再提供理由或依据；回应他人时先准确理解其立场。不同意时使用委婉表达，针对观点进行讨论，不攻击个人。

exercises.stem: During a class discussion, Amy says, “I think students should have less homework because they need more time to rest.” Which reply best expresses a different opinion politely and gives a reason?

choices.label: A
choices.text: You're wrong. Stop talking.

choices.label: B
choices.text: I see your point, but I disagree. Some homework helps us review what we learn.

choices.label: C
choices.text: I agree with everything, but homework is useless.

choices.label: D
choices.text: I don't know. Ask somebody else.

exercises.explanation: B先表示理解对方观点，再礼貌地表达不同意，并给出“作业有助于复习”的理由，符合表达观点和态度的交际要求。A直接攻击他人，C前后矛盾，D没有清楚表达立场。

keypoints.title: 问候告别的含义
keypoints.body: 问候与告别是在交往开始和结束时，用恰当语言或方式表示友好、尊重和关注，建立或结束互动的交际功能。

keypoints.title: 适应场合表达
keypoints.body: 根据双方关系、时间和场合选择表达：熟人之间可较随意，正式场合应礼貌得体。告别时可说明离开、表达祝愿或约定下次联系，并回应对方。

exercises.stem: You meet your new English teacher at 8:00 a.m. for the first time. After a short talk, you need to leave. Which exchange is most appropriate?

choices.label: A
choices.text: “Hey, Ms. Brown! What's up?” “Later!”

choices.label: B
choices.text: “Good morning, Ms. Brown. It's nice to meet you.” “Thank you. Goodbye. Have a nice day.”

choices.label: C
choices.text: “Good evening, Ms. Brown.” “Good night. See you yesterday.”

choices.label: D
choices.text: “Hello, Brown.” “Bye-bye, old friend.”

exercises.explanation: 早上第一次见新老师，应使用“Good morning”和礼貌的称呼；离开时可说“Goodbye”并表达祝愿。B符合正式场合、师生关系和时间要求。A、D过于随意，C的时间表达和“See you yesterday”不恰当。

keypoints.title: 邀请与应答的含义
keypoints.body: 邀请是请他人参加活动、到某处或一起做某事；应答包括接受、拒绝或询问细节。应答时要回应邀请内容，并根据实际情况礼貌表达。

keypoints.title: 邀请和回应的表达
keypoints.body: 邀请可用 Would you like to…?、Shall we…?；接受可说 That sounds great. 或 I’d love to.；拒绝应先致谢，再说明原因，如 Thanks, but I can’t. 必要时提出替代安排。

exercises.stem: Ben: “Would you like to join us for a basketball game this Saturday afternoon?” You have to visit your grandmother that day. What is the best reply?

choices.label: A
choices.text: No. I don't want to go with you.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Thanks for inviting me, but I can't. I have to visit my grandmother. How about next Saturday?

choices.label: C
choices.text: Yes, I can. I will visit her on Saturday.

choices.label: D
choices.text: What basketball?

exercises.explanation: B先感谢对方邀请，再礼貌拒绝并说明不能参加的原因，最后提出下周六的替代安排，完整回应了邀请。A语气生硬，C前后意思矛盾，D没有回应邀请内容。

keypoints.title: 请求与提供帮助
keypoints.body: 请求是请他人为自己做某事或给予帮助；提供帮助是主动表示愿意为他人做某事。两者都应结合交际对象和场合，选择恰当、礼貌的表达。

keypoints.title: 提出请求和帮助
keypoints.body: 请求可用 Could you…?、Would you mind…?；提供帮助可用 Can I help you?、Shall I…? 对方可用 Yes, please. 接受，或 No, thank you. 礼貌拒绝，并在必要时说明原因。

exercises.stem: 同学抱着一摞书走进教室，看起来很吃力。你想礼貌地主动提供帮助，你说：“____”同学回答：“Yes, please. Could you carry some of these books?”

choices.label: A
choices.text: Can I help you?

choices.label: B
choices.text: Would you mind carrying my books?

choices.label: C
choices.text: You should carry these books.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Why don't you carry them yourself?

exercises.explanation: Can I help you? 是主动、礼貌地提供帮助的表达；对方可以用 Yes, please. 接受。B 是请求对方帮助自己，C 带有指令意味，D 语气不礼貌。

keypoints.title: 建议与劝告的含义
keypoints.body: 建议与劝告是针对某种问题或行动提出看法，帮助对方选择更合适的做法；它们通常保留对方自主决定的空间，不等同于命令。

keypoints.title: 得体提出建议
keypoints.body: 可用 You should…、Why don’t you…?、How about…? 或 If I were you, I would…；正式或敏感场合可加 In my opinion、Maybe 等，使语气更委婉，并尊重对方的选择。

exercises.stem: 你的朋友说：“I often feel tired in class because I use my phone until midnight.” 下面哪种回答最适合作为礼貌的建议？

choices.label: A
choices.text: You must stop using your phone now!

choices.label: B
choices.text: How about putting your phone away earlier and going to bed on time?

choices.label: C
choices.text: Give me your phone.

choices.label: D
choices.text: You are tired.

exercises.explanation: How about...？用于提出建议，语气较委婉，也保留了对方自主选择的空间。A 语气像命令，C 是直接要求，D 只是陈述事实，都不是得体的建议表达。

keypoints.title: 直接与委婉表达
keypoints.body: 直接表达明确说出请求、意见或态度，信息清晰、语气较有力度；委婉表达借助疑问句、情态词、缓和语或间接提示降低强制感，具体含义需结合语境理解。

keypoints.title: 表达方式的选择
keypoints.body: 选择直接或委婉表达时，要考虑交际目的、场合正式程度、双方关系和身份。直接不一定失礼，委婉也不能含糊到影响理解，应在清楚与得体之间取得平衡。

exercises.stem: 在学校图书馆里，你想请一位不太熟悉的同学小声一些。下面哪种表达最得体、清楚？

choices.label: A
choices.text: Be quiet!

choices.label: B
choices.text: You are too noisy.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Could you please speak more quietly?

choices.label: D
choices.text: Stop talking!

exercises.explanation: 图书馆是较正式、需要保持安静的场合，对不太熟悉的同学应使用委婉但明确的请求。Could you please...？降低了强制感，同时清楚表达了“请小声说”的意思。A、B、D 语气直接且生硬。

keypoints.title: 语体的基本含义
keypoints.body: 正式语体与非正式语体是根据交际场合、对象、关系和目的选择的两类语言表达方式。前者适用于较庄重、规范的场合，后者适用于熟人之间或轻松的日常交际。

keypoints.title: 表达风格随情境变化
keypoints.body: 正式语体通常措辞规范、语气克制，较少使用俚语和随意缩略；非正式语体更口语化、亲切灵活。二者不是“正确”与“错误”的区别，得体取决于情境。

exercises.stem: A student is writing an email to the school principal to ask for two more days to finish a project. Which sentence is most suitable for this formal situation?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Hey, can you give me two more days? I'm really busy.

choices.label: B
choices.text: I would like to ask whether it would be possible to extend the deadline by two days.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Gimme two more days, please.

choices.label: D
choices.text: I need two more days, okay?

exercises.explanation: 给校长写邮件属于较正式的交际场合。B使用了“I would like to ask whether...”和“extend the deadline”等较规范、克制的表达，符合正式语体。A、C、D更口语化或语气较直接，适合非正式场合。

keypoints.title: 礼貌用语的基本作用
keypoints.body: 礼貌用语是交际中用来表示尊重、体谅和友善的词语或表达方式，能够使请求、感谢、道歉、拒绝等言语行为更得体，减少误解和冲突。

keypoints.title: 按交际目的选择
keypoints.body: 提出请求可使用“请”“能否”“请问”等表达，获得帮助后及时致谢；打扰或造成不便时道歉，开始询问可先致意。还要根据对象、距离和场合调整语气，避免命令、生硬或过度客套。

exercises.stem: You want to borrow an eraser from a classmate. Which sentence is the most polite and natural request?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Give me your eraser.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Could you please lend me your eraser for a moment?

choices.label: C
choices.text: You must lend me your eraser.

choices.label: D
choices.text: I want your eraser now.

exercises.explanation: B使用“Could you please...”提出请求，既表达了请求目的，又体现了尊重和友善；“lend me...for a moment”还说明了借用时间。其他选项语气像命令或要求，容易让对方感到不礼貌。

keypoints.title: 口语和书面语的定义
keypoints.body: 口语是通过说话进行的语言表达，依赖即时互动和现场语境；书面语是通过文字进行的语言表达，便于保存、修改和传播。二者在表达方式、组织结构和用词习惯上存在差异。

keypoints.title: 组织方式各有特点
keypoints.body: 口语常见短句、重复、停顿和省略，表达较为自然灵活；书面语通常结构完整、衔接清楚、用词更严谨，信息表达也更明确。实际交际中二者可以相互影响。

exercises.stem: A teacher says, “Well, we’re gonna start at nine, okay?” Which sentence is most suitable for a written notice?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Well, we're gonna start at nine, okay?

choices.label: B
choices.text: The activity will begin at 9:00 a.m.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Um, we're starting at nine.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Start at nine, yeah?

exercises.explanation: 口语中常出现“Well”“Um”等停顿语、缩略形式“we’re gonna”和反意疑问式结尾。书面语通常结构完整、表达明确，因此B更适合写在通知中。

keypoints.title: 反义词的基本含义
keypoints.body: 反义词是意义相反或相对的词，双方通常属于同一词性，并在同一语义范围内形成对比，如“高—低”“早—晚”。有些反义关系是相对的，并非所有词都存在唯一对应的反义词。

keypoints.title: 结合语境判断反义
keypoints.body: 判断反义词时，先确认词义和词性，再看它们是否在同一方面形成对立；不能只凭词形添加或删去前缀来猜测。遇到多义词，应依据句中具体义项选择反义词。

exercises.stem: In the sentence “The classroom was quiet before the bell, but it became ___ when the students came in,” which word is opposite in meaning to “quiet”?

choices.label: A
choices.text: noisy

choices.label: B
choices.text: noise

choices.label: C
choices.text: slowly

choices.label: D
choices.text: empty

exercises.explanation: “Quiet”和“noisy”都用来描述环境的声音状况，词性都是形容词，且在本句中形成反义对比。 “Noise”是名词，“slowly”是副词，不能与“quiet”构成同词性反义关系。

keypoints.title: 基本义与语境义
keypoints.body: 基本义是词在语言中较稳定、较概括的核心意义；语境义是词在具体句子或语篇中，受上下文、搭配和表达目的影响而呈现的具体意义，可能是基本义的引申或特殊用法。

keypoints.title: 结合语境确定词义
keypoints.body: 先了解词的基本义，再观察其所在句子的上下文、搭配、句法关系和语篇主题，判断词在此处的具体含义；不能只依据词典中的第一个释义或逐词直译。

exercises.stem: In the sentence “Mia is the head of the school art club,” what does “head” mean here?

choices.label: A
choices.text: the part of the body above the neck

choices.label: B
choices.text: the leader or person in charge

choices.label: C
choices.text: the top surface of something

choices.label: D
choices.text: a kind of hair

exercises.explanation: “Head”的基本义可以指“头部”，但在“the head of the club”这一搭配和语境中，它表示俱乐部的负责人或领导者，是由基本义引申出的语境义。

keypoints.title: 词性与词形变化
keypoints.body: 词性是词在句中所属的语法类别及所承担的功能，如名词、动词、形容词和副词等；词形变化是词为表达数、时态、语态、比较级等语法意义而产生的形式变化。

keypoints.title: 判断词性并变形
keypoints.body: 先看词在句中的位置、句法功能及前后搭配，再判断词性；随后根据主谓一致、时态、语态、单复数或比较关系，选择正确的词形。

exercises.stem: 根据句子结构和语法意义，用括号内单词的适当形式填空：There are three ___ (box) on the desk. Lisa ___ (study) English every evening.
exercises.explanation: 第一空前有数词“three”，后面的可数名词要用复数形式；“box”变复数时加“es”，为“boxes”。第二空主语“Lisa”是第三人称单数，且“every evening”表示一般现在时，因此“study”要变为第三人称单数形式“studies”。

keypoints.title: 一词多义的含义
keypoints.body: 一词多义是同一个词在不同语境中具有两个或多个相互关联的意义。这些意义通常由基本义通过引申、比喻或功能扩展形成。

keypoints.title: 根据语境辨析词义
keypoints.body: 结合词的词性、搭配对象、句法结构和上下文，判断该词在句中的具体意义；遇到熟词时也要联系语篇核对，不能机械套用最熟悉的释义。

exercises.stem:
根据语境，判断下列句子中 run 的含义。
① The boy runs in the park every morning.
② A small river runs through the village.
下列说法正确的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: ①和②中的 run 都表示“跑步”。

choices.label: B
choices.text: ①表示“跑步”，②表示“流经”；②中的意义由“移动”引申而来。

choices.label: C
choices.text: ①表示“流经”，②表示“跑步”。

choices.label: D
choices.text: ①中的 run 是名词，②中的 run 是形容词。

exercises.explanation: 句①的主语是 boy，表示男孩在公园跑步；句②的主语是 river，结合 through the village 可知表示河流流经村庄。两种意义都包含“移动”的基本概念，后者是由基本义引申而来，需根据语境判断。

keypoints.title: 同义词与近义词
keypoints.body: 同义词的意义相同或基本相同，近义词则只在核心意义上相近。它们可能在适用对象、搭配习惯、语体、感情色彩、程度或语法功能方面存在差异，因此通常不能随意互换。

keypoints.title: 结合差异选择词语
keypoints.body: 先确定语境所需的共同意义，再比较候选词的搭配、使用对象、正式程度、感情色彩和语法特点；可将词语代入原句检验是否自然、准确。

exercises.stem: 选择适当的词完成句子。\nMay I ______ your dictionary for two days? I will return it on Friday.

choices.label: A
choices.text: borrow

choices.label: B
choices.text: lend

choices.label: C
choices.text: send

choices.label: D
choices.text: keep

exercises.explanation: borrow 表示“借入”，主语是借东西的人，常用结构为 borrow something from somebody。句中说话人想从对方那里借词典，因此选 borrow。lend 表示“借出”，主语应是提供词典的人。

keypoints.title: 固定搭配的含义
keypoints.body: 常见固定搭配是英语中词语按约定习惯稳定组合形成的表达，成员和结构通常不能任意替换，意义也有相对固定的用法，如 make a decision、be interested in。

keypoints.title: 整体记忆与使用
keypoints.body: 学习固定搭配时要把词组作为整体，连同含义、介词、冠词和语法形式一起记忆，并在具体语境中使用，避免按汉语逐词拼接。

exercises.stem: 用适当的介词填空。\nThe students are interested ______ joining the English club.
exercises.explanation: be interested in 是固定搭配，表示“对……感兴趣”。介词 in 不能按照汉语逐词翻译或随意替换，因此句子应填 in。

keypoints.title: 习惯用语的特点
keypoints.body: 习惯用语是人们长期使用而形成的固定表达，整体意义常不能由各个词的字面意义直接相加得到，如 break the ice 表示“打破僵局”。

keypoints.title: 避免望文生义
keypoints.body: 理解习惯用语不能只按字面翻译，也不能随意替换其中的词；应结合上下文判断整体意义，并注意其适用场合和语体。

exercises.stem: 新学期第一次班会时，大家都很安静。为了让同学们放松，班长讲了一个笑话，成功地“break the ice”。What does “break the ice” mean here?

choices.label: A
choices.text: 使冰融化

choices.label: B
choices.text: 打破僵局，使气氛轻松

choices.label: C
choices.text: 在冰上走路

choices.label: D
choices.text: 把冰敲碎

exercises.explanation: break the ice 是习惯用语，不能按字面理解为“打破冰块”。结合班会中大家安静、班长讲笑话的语境，它表示打破初次见面或尴尬的僵局，使人放松并开始交流。

keypoints.title: 介词短语的构成
keypoints.body: 介词短语通常由介词和名词、代词、动名词等构成，整体可在句中作定语、状语或表语，表示时间、地点、方式、对象、原因等关系，如 in the room、by bus。

keypoints.title: 介词与后接成分
keypoints.body: 选择介词要依据固定搭配和具体语境，不能简单按汉语逐字对应；介词后接代词时用宾格，接动词时通常用动名词形式。

exercises.stem: 下列句子中，介词短语的使用正确的一项是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: Tina is good at draw pictures.

choices.label: B
choices.text: We go to the museum by bus.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Tom went to school with he.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Lucy is interested on music.

exercises.explanation: B 中 by bus 是介词短语，表示交通方式，搭配正确。介词 at 后接动词时通常用动名词，应为 drawing；介词 with 后接代词宾格，应为 him；be interested in 是固定搭配，不能用 interested on。

keypoints.title: 动词短语的结构
keypoints.body: 动词短语以动词为核心，可由动词与副词、介词、宾语或补语等组成，整体表示动作或状态，如 look up、take care of、has finished the work。

keypoints.title: 注意动词短语用法
keypoints.body: 使用动词短语时要判断其及物性、宾语位置和能否分开：pick up the book 可改为 pick the book up，但代词必须放在中间，作 pick it up。

exercises.stem: The book is on the floor. Please ______ before class begins.

choices.label: A
choices.text: pick up it

choices.label: B
choices.text: pick it up

choices.label: C
choices.text: pick up them

choices.label: D
choices.text: pick them up

exercises.explanation: pick up 是动词短语，意为“捡起”。当宾语是名词时，名词可放在 up 后；当宾语是代词时，代词必须放在动词和副词之间，所以 book 用代词 it，正确形式是 pick it up。

keypoints.title: 范围与用途
keypoints.body: 三级词汇是英语学习中约1600个常用词的词汇要求，学习者应围绕相关主题理解并使用这些词进行交流和表达；还可按需要接触少量主题扩展词及习惯用语、固定搭配。

keypoints.title: 学习与运用
keypoints.body: 按主题建立词汇网络，掌握词义、词性、常见搭配和基本用法，并在听、说、读、写任务中反复调用；不要只背中文释义，要结合语境判断和表达。

exercises.stem: 在“健康生活”主题学习中，下面哪种做法最符合三级词汇（约1600词）的学习与运用要求？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 把词表中的英文逐个译成中文并反复默写，暂时不必关注句子和使用场合。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 围绕主题建立词汇网络，记录词义、词性和常见搭配，并在听、说、读、写活动中反复使用。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 尽量选择生僻、复杂的词汇，常用词只要认识中文意思即可。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 每个词只记住一个固定的中文意思，所有语境都使用同一种表达。

exercises.explanation: 三级词汇不仅要求认识约1600个常用词，还要求围绕主题理解并使用这些词进行交流和表达。学习时应结合语境掌握词义、词性和搭配，并在听说读写中反复运用，不能只背中文释义。

keypoints.title: 范围与定位
keypoints.body: 三级+词汇是比三级词汇更高一档的词汇要求，核心规模约1800个单词，服务于相关主题下的理解、交流与表达，并可按实际需要补充约200个主题词及一定数量的习惯用语或固定搭配。

keypoints.title: 与三级词汇的关系
keypoints.body: 它以三级约1600词为基础，在原有词汇能力上继续扩展约200词。学习时应先巩固基础词的常用义和搭配，再通过主题阅读、听说活动吸收新增词汇，逐步提升表达的准确性和丰富性。

exercises.stem: 关于三级+词汇（约1800词）的理解与学习，下面哪项说法正确？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 三级+词汇以三级约1600词为基础，再扩展约200词；应先巩固基础词的常用义和搭配，再通过主题活动吸收新增词汇。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 三级+词汇中的约1800词全部是全新的词，因此可以不必学习三级词汇。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 三级+词汇只要求记住单词的中文意思，不要求在主题语境中使用。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 只要掌握新增的约200词就可以，原有三级词汇的搭配和用法不需要复习。

exercises.explanation: 三级+词汇是在三级约1600词基础上的提升，核心规模约1800词，新增部分约200词。学习应先巩固基础词的常用义和搭配，再在主题阅读、听说等活动中学习新增词汇，从而提高表达的准确性和丰富性。

keypoints.title: 含义与范围
keypoints.body: 主题范围内的扩展词汇，是围绕学习主题，在规定核心词汇之外按需要接触和学习的词语，通常可补充约100—300个，具体数量随主题与学习需要调整，也包括相关习惯用语和固定搭配。

keypoints.title: 在语境中掌握
keypoints.body: 从主题语篇、任务和真实交流中收集扩展词，先借助上下文、构词和图片等线索理解，再记录词义、词性与搭配，并用自己的句子或对话复现，避免脱离主题孤立背诵。

exercises.stem: 某班开展“校园环保”主题学习。教师从语篇中补充了 compost、compost bin 等核心词汇之外的词语，并要求学生在对话中使用。下列哪种做法最符合主题范围内扩展词汇的学习要求？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 把所有不是核心词的词语都脱离语篇单独背诵，并要求每个主题补足完全相同的数量。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 围绕环保主题按需要学习这些词，借助上下文、构词或图片线索初步理解，再查证并记录词义、词性和搭配，最后用自己的句子或对话复现。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 只记住 compost 的一个中文意思，不必了解它在 compost bin 中的用法。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 认为扩展词汇不属于学习内容，遇到不认识的词一律跳过，也不必在交流中使用。

exercises.explanation: 主题范围内的扩展词汇是在核心词汇之外，围绕主题按需接触和学习的词语，数量会随主题和学习需要调整，通常约为100—300个，也可包括固定搭配。掌握这类词应结合语篇和任务，利用上下文等线索理解，再记录词义、词性、搭配并通过自己的表达加以复现。

keypoints.title: 缩略词是什么
keypoints.body: 缩略词是把较长的词、短语或名称压缩成较短形式的词语或表达，常由首字母、词的一部分或删减形式构成；其具体读法和书写方式需结合约定与语境判断。

keypoints.title: 理解缩略词
keypoints.body: 遇到缩略词时，先结合文章主题、前后文和标点推测，再根据首字母或保留部分还原完整表达，并用完整含义检验句意；首次出现时要确认其所指。

exercises.stem: 阅读通知："The PTA will meet on Friday. Parents and teachers should arrive at 3 p.m." 根据首字母和上下文，PTA 最可能指什么？

choices.label: A
choices.text: Parents and Teachers Association

choices.label: B
choices.text: Parents' Travel Agency

choices.label: C
choices.text: Public Transport Area

choices.label: D
choices.text: Primary Test Activity

exercises.explanation: PTA 的三个首字母分别对应 Parents、Teachers 和 Association；通知中提到 parents and teachers 要参加会议，因此 PTA 指 Parents and Teachers Association（家长和教师协会）。

keypoints.title: 合成词是什么
keypoints.body: 合成词是由两个或两个以上词素（通常是词根）组合而成的新词，各组成部分共同构成整体意义，如 classroom 由 class 和 room 组成。

keypoints.title: 根据构成推测词义
keypoints.body: 遇到合成生词时，先分别辨认各组成部分，再结合它们的意义关系和上下文推测整体含义；不能只把字面义机械相加，还要用句意验证。

exercises.stem: 在句子 “Mia bought a storybook at the bookstore.” 中，bookstore 是由 book 和 store 组成的合成词。结合句意，bookstore 最可能指什么？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 一本关于商店的书

choices.label: B
choices.text: 出售书籍的商店

choices.label: C
choices.text: 存放书包的房间

choices.label: D
choices.text: 读书用的桌子

exercises.explanation: bookstore 由 book（书）和 store（商店）组成。结合 Mia bought a storybook（买了一本故事书）的语境，bookstore 应理解为出售书籍的商店，而不是把两个词的字面意义机械相加。

keypoints.title: 转化法是什么
keypoints.body: 转化法是不添加词缀、基本不改变词形，使同一词形转作另一词类并获得相应词义的构词方法，如 email 可作名词“电子邮件”，也可作动词“发电子邮件”。

keypoints.title: 根据句法判断词义
keypoints.body: 判断转化词时，先观察它在句中的位置、搭配和语法功能，确定词类，再结合上下文选择恰当词义，不要只依据词形或熟悉的词类解释。

exercises.stem: 比较下面两句中 email 的用法：① Tom sent me an email. ② Please email the photo to me tonight. 第二句中的 email 是什么词类，意思是什么？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 名词，电子邮件

choices.label: B
choices.text: 动词，发送电子邮件

choices.label: C
choices.text: 形容词，电子的

choices.label: D
choices.text: 名词，电子邮箱地址

exercises.explanation: 第二句中 email 位于祈使句中，Please 后面接动词，且后面有宾语 the photo，因此 email 在这里是动词，意为“发送电子邮件”。它与第一句中的名词 email 词形相同，体现了转化法。

keypoints.title: 前缀是什么
keypoints.body: 前缀是加在词根或词基前面的构词成分，通常不能单独成词，主要用来补充、改变或否定原词义，如 un- 表示“不”，re- 表示“再、重新”。

keypoints.title: 前缀的主要作用
keypoints.body: 前缀通常改变词义而不改变词类，但这不是绝对规律。识别前缀时，应结合词根、前缀含义和上下文判断整个单词的意义。

exercises.stem: Read the sentence: “Tom was unhappy because he lost his favorite toy.” What does the prefix **un-** do in **unhappy**?

choices.label: A
choices.text: It gives the word the opposite or negative meaning of “happy”.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It means “again” and shows that Tom became happy again.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It changes the word into a noun meaning “happiness”.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It shows that the toy belongs to Tom.

exercises.explanation: The prefix un- is added before happy and usually means “not” or gives an opposite meaning. Therefore, unhappy means “not happy.” The word remains an adjective, so the prefix mainly changes the meaning rather than the word class.

keypoints.title: 后缀是什么
keypoints.body: 后缀是附加在词根或词基末尾的构词成分，通常不能独立成词，可构成新词、改变词义或改变词类，如 -ness 常构成名词，-ful 常构成形容词。

keypoints.title: 利用后缀识别词义
keypoints.body: 遇到生词时，先观察词尾是否含有常见后缀，再根据后缀判断词类和大致意义，结合词根及上下文确定完整词义，并注意拼写变化。

exercises.stem: Read the sentence: “The coach praised Lily’s helpfulness during the team game.” What can we learn from the suffix **-ness** in **helpfulness**?

choices.label: A
choices.text: It makes the word an adjective meaning “full of help.”

choices.label: B
choices.text: It makes the word a noun referring to the quality or state of being helpful.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It gives the word the meaning “help again.”

choices.label: D
choices.text: It makes the word a verb showing an action.

exercises.explanation: The suffix -ness is added to helpful and commonly forms a noun. Helpfulness means the quality or state of being helpful, and its position at the end of the word and its noun use in the sentence support this conclusion.

keypoints.title: 词根的含义
keypoints.body: 词根是单词中承载基本词汇意义的核心部分。同一词根常出现在一组相关词中，词根有时能独立成词，有时必须与词缀结合。

keypoints.title: 利用词根猜词
keypoints.body: 先找出单词中反复出现的核心部分，再结合前缀、后缀判断词义方向和词性，最后用句子或语篇语境检验推测是否合理。

exercises.stem: Look at these words: **preview, view, review**. Which part is the common root, and what basic meaning does it carry?

choices.label: A
choices.text: pre-, meaning “before”

choices.label: B
choices.text: re-, meaning “again”

choices.label: C
choices.text: view, meaning “see” or “look”

choices.label: D
choices.text: -view, meaning “person”

exercises.explanation: The part view appears in all three words and carries the basic vocabulary meaning related to seeing or looking. The prefixes pre- and re- add the meanings “before” and “again,” so view is the root in this word group.

keypoints.title: 语境推断生词
keypoints.body: 借助语境克服生词障碍，是利用生词前后的词句、语篇主题、说话者语气和已知信息，推测其大致意义，不因一个词而中断整体理解。

keypoints.title: 听力中的推断步骤
keypoints.body: 先抓主题、人物和关键词，再留意解释、举例、转折、因果及重复信息，判断生词的大致词义；无法确定时保留合理猜测，继续听并结合后文修正。

exercises.stem:
听下面的对话，选择画线词“mishap”在语境中最可能的意思。

Girl: How was your class trip to the museum?
Boy: It was great, except for a small mishap. Our bus broke down on the way there, so we arrived thirty minutes late. Luckily, no one was hurt, and we still enjoyed the visit.

What does “mishap” most probably mean?

choices.label: A
choices.text: 一次小意外

choices.label: B
choices.text: 一场重要比赛

choices.label: C
choices.text: 一个有趣展览

choices.label: D
choices.text: 一种交通工具

exercises.explanation: “mishap”后面的内容说明公交车途中抛锚、到达晚，但无人受伤，说明这是一次不严重的意外。因此选A。听到生词时，可以根据后文的具体事例和转折信息推断大意。

keypoints.title: 身份与场景判断
keypoints.body: 判断说话者身份与场景，是根据称呼、自我介绍、谈话内容、双方关系、语气及背景声音等线索，推断谁在什么地点或情境中说话。

keypoints.title: 整合线索作判断
keypoints.body: 先寻找人物称呼、职业或任务等身份线索，再关注地点、时间、活动和交谈目的；将多条线索相互印证，避免只凭一个词或单一声音作答。

exercises.stem:
听下面的对话，根据称呼、谈话内容和双方的任务判断说话者身份与场景。

Man: Good afternoon. I'd like to return this jacket. It is too small for me.
Woman: Do you have the receipt?
Man: Yes, here it is.
Woman: Thank you. You can exchange it for a larger one or get your money back.

Where are the speakers most probably?

choices.label: A
choices.text: At a clothing store

choices.label: B
choices.text: At a hospital

choices.label: C
choices.text: At a train station

choices.label: D
choices.text: In a classroom

exercises.explanation: 男士要退夹克，女士询问购物小票，并提出换大号或退款。这些线索共同表明双方在服装店，女士可能是店员，男士是顾客。因此选A，不能只根据单个词作判断。

keypoints.title: 说话者意图
keypoints.body: 说话者意图是说话者希望通过话语达到的目的或表达的态度，如请求、建议、邀请、提醒、警告、道歉或拒绝，不等同于字面信息。

keypoints.title: 推断表达意图
keypoints.body: 结合具体语境、说话者与听话者的关系、关键词、语气重音及对话结果，判断其真正目的；对含蓄表达要联系前后内容，而不能只按字面理解。

exercises.stem:
听下面的对话，判断女孩最后一句话的真实意图。

Boy: Would you like to come to the school picnic with us on Saturday?
Girl: I'd love to, but I have to look after my little brother that day.
Boy: That's too bad. Maybe next time.

What does the girl really mean?

choices.label: A
choices.text: She is inviting the boy to her home.

choices.label: B
choices.text: She is politely refusing the invitation.

choices.label: C
choices.text: She is asking the boy to look after her brother.

choices.label: D
choices.text: She is reminding the boy about the picnic.

exercises.explanation: “I'd love to, but...”字面上先表示愿意，后面的“不得不照看弟弟”说明她当天无法参加；男孩说“Maybe next time”也印证了这一点。因此女孩是在礼貌地拒绝邀请，而不是再次发出邀请。

keypoints.title: 关键细节的含义
keypoints.body: 获取关键细节是从口语语篇中找出支撑主题和主要内容的重要信息，如人物、时间、地点、原因、过程、结果和具体数据等。

keypoints.title: 抓住重要信息
keypoints.body: 听前先看问题，听时关注疑问词、数字、时间和转折、因果等提示语，及时记录关键词；听后结合上下文核对信息，避免只凭零散词语作答。

exercises.stem:
录音稿（播放时不向学生展示文字）：
Boy: Are you joining the school gardening activity this Saturday?
Girl: Yes. It starts at 9:00 a.m. in the school garden. Please bring a pair of gloves. The meeting place was changed from the playground to the garden because the playground is being painted.
问题：What time will the activity start?

choices.label: A
choices.text: At 8:30 a.m.

choices.label: B
choices.text: At 9:00 a.m.

choices.label: C
choices.text: At 9:30 a.m.

exercises.explanation: 听到“It starts at 9:00 a.m.”即可确定活动开始时间为上午9点。作答时应关注疑问词“What time”和录音中的具体数字，而不要被地点、物品等其他细节干扰。

keypoints.title: 主旨要义的含义
keypoints.body: 获取主旨要义是概括口语语篇的整体主题、核心内容或交际目的，回答“主要讲什么”或“说话者想表达什么”，而不是复述某个细节。

keypoints.title: 概括整体内容
keypoints.body: 综合开头、结尾、反复出现的词语和各部分内容，判断中心信息及说话目的，再用简洁的一句话概括；要区分主旨与例子、原因等支撑细节。

exercises.stem:
录音稿（播放时不向学生展示文字）：
Hello, everyone. Next week is Walk-to-School Week. From Monday to Friday, try to walk or ride a bike to school. These choices keep us healthy and help reduce air pollution. If you live far away, you can get off the bus one stop early and walk the rest. On Friday, the class with the most students taking part will receive a small tree. Let’s leave our cars at home and enjoy a greener week!
问题：What is the announcement mainly about?

choices.label: A
choices.text: How to grow a tree at school.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A school campaign encouraging students to travel in greener ways.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Why some students live far from school.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A competition about different kinds of buses.

exercises.explanation: 录音开头点明是“Walk-to-School Week”，中间介绍步行、骑车等绿色出行方式，结尾再次号召大家少开车。因此主旨是学校发起绿色出行活动，而不是某个细节，如奖励一棵树或乘车方式。

keypoints.title: 语调与情感态度
keypoints.body: 根据语调判断情感与态度，是通过音高、重音、语速、停顿等变化，结合语境推断说话者的喜悦、疑惑、强调、赞同或不满等情绪和立场。

keypoints.title: 结合变化作判断
keypoints.body: 先比较同一语篇中语调的升降、轻重和快慢，再联系词语和情境判断情感态度的变化。不能只依据某一次升调或降调下结论，应综合语音和语境。

exercises.stem:
录音稿（括号内为朗读提示，实际录音时不读括号）：
Boy: I heard the school concert was wonderful. Did you enjoy it?
Girl: Well... it was okay.（“Well”后停顿较长，整体语速较慢，重读“okay”，并用较低的降调）
问题：What is the girl’s attitude toward the concert?

choices.label: A
choices.text: She is very excited and wants to praise it.

choices.label: B
choices.text: She is not very satisfied with it.

choices.label: C
choices.text: She is angry with the boy.

choices.label: D
choices.text: She is afraid of performing in it.

exercises.explanation: 女孩没有直接说“不喜欢”，但“Well”后的较长停顿、较慢语速以及对“okay”的重读和低降调，表明她的评价较勉强，满意度不高。结合男孩称赞音乐会的语境，可判断她并不十分满意，而不是兴奋赞扬或生气。

keypoints.title: 记录听力要点
keypoints.body: 边听边记录要点是在理解口语内容的同时，用关键词、短语、符号或简图记录主题、关键事实及其关系，而不是逐字抄写全部内容。

keypoints.title: 简明快速记录
keypoints.body: 听前预留分区并确定记录重点；听时抓关键词、数字和逻辑关系，使用缩写、符号或箭头，暂时没听清处先留空；听后依据上下文补全和整理。

exercises.stem: 你将听到一段校园通知（可由教师朗读）：“Our school will hold a book sale in the library this Friday, from 3:30 to 5:00 p.m. Students should bring used books on Wednesday. The money from the sale will be used to buy books for the reading club.” 听后，哪一项最符合“边听边记录要点”的做法？

choices.label: A
choices.text: Our school will hold a book sale in the library this Friday, from 3:30 to 5:00 p.m. Students should bring used books on Wednesday. The money from the sale will be used to buy books for the reading club.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Book sale—library; Fri 3:30–5:00; bring used books Wed; money → reading-club books

choices.label: C
choices.text: Book sale; Friday; books

choices.label: D
choices.text: Library—Wednesday; sale—reading club; 3:30–5:00

exercises.explanation: B 用关键词、短语和箭头记录了活动主题、地点、时间、学生要做的事以及收入用途，保留了关键信息及其关系，没有逐字抄写。A 过于完整，C 遗漏了重要信息，D 混淆了时间、地点和用途。

keypoints.title: 预测听力内容是什么
keypoints.body: 根据已听信息、标题、场景、说话者身份及语音语调等线索，推测后续可能出现的话题、信息或态度，并随着新信息的出现及时修正预测。

keypoints.title: 利用线索预测后文
keypoints.body: 听前先看标题、图片或问题，形成初步预期；听中抓住开头、转折、重复和语调变化，推测下一步内容。预测应以线索为依据，不能只凭个人猜想。

exercises.stem: 听力标题为“A Surprise for Grandma”。开头听到：“Tom, please don't go into the kitchen yet. We need five more minutes. The cake is almost ready.” 根据标题和已听到的线索，下面哪项最可能是后文内容？

choices.label: A
choices.text: Tom will go to school for a science test.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Tom and the others will finish the cake and give it to Grandma as a surprise.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The family will discuss the rules of a football match.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Grandma will repair the kitchen clock.

exercises.explanation: 标题直接提供了“给奶奶一个惊喜”的线索，厨房、暂时不能进入以及蛋糕快做好了又说明大家正在准备相关活动，因此后文最可能是完成蛋糕并把它作为惊喜送给奶奶。这个预测有听到的线索依据，而不是凭空猜想。

keypoints.title: 从重复停顿理解话语
keypoints.body: 通过关注说话者对词句的重复、重读和停顿，判断其强调、犹豫、修正或补充的意图，从而抓住话语中的重点信息和真实含义。

keypoints.title: 结合语境分析停顿
keypoints.body: 重复出现的词句通常是重点，也可能表示修正或确认；停顿前后常有信息转换或补充。应把重复、停顿与上下文结合起来理解，避免孤立解释。

exercises.stem: 听到如下对话片段：A: Are we meeting at the library at four? B: At four... at four thirty, actually. The bus is late. 问：B 的重复和停顿在这里主要表达什么？

choices.label: A
choices.text: B 在强调会议地点是图书馆。

choices.label: B
choices.text: B 先重复原来的时间，随后把时间修正为四点半。

choices.label: C
choices.text: B 完全没有听清 A 的问题。

choices.label: D
choices.text: B 在补充图书馆的位置。

exercises.explanation: B 先说“At four”，停顿后又说“At four thirty, actually”，说明他正在修正原来的时间；“The bus is late”进一步解释了改时间的原因。理解重复和停顿时要结合上下文，不能只把重复看作简单反复。

keypoints.title: 作者观点与态度
keypoints.body: 作者观点是作者对话题或对象的看法、判断和立场；作者态度是作者表现出的赞成、反对、质疑、客观或情感倾向。二者应依据全文信息综合判断。

keypoints.title: 依据文本判断立场
keypoints.body: 重点关注标题、开头、结尾、转折句和评价性词语，结合论据与行文语气概括作者立场；还要区分作者观点与文中他人的观点。

exercises.stem:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Title: Let Students Help Plan School Events

At our school, teachers used to decide almost everything about school events. Some students complained that their ideas were never heard. Others, like Ben, said that students were too young to make good plans. Last month, the head teacher tried a new idea: each class chose two students to join an event-planning meeting. The students suggested a used-book sale and a sports afternoon. They also helped set times and made posters. The events went smoothly, and many families came. Of course, a few ideas had to be changed because they cost too much or were unsafe. However, the meetings taught students to listen, plan, and take responsibility. In my opinion, students should not make every decision alone, but schools should give them a real chance to help. This small change made school events more interesting and meaningful.

What is the author's attitude toward letting students help plan school events?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Supportive, while recognizing that adults still need to guide students.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Strongly opposed because students are too inexperienced.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Uncertain, because the author gives no clear opinion.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Completely supportive of students making every decision without adults.

exercises.explanation: 作者总体支持让学生参与学校活动的策划，因为文中说这种做法使活动更有趣、更有意义，也能培养学生的责任感。但作者同时指出学生不应独自作出所有决定，说明作者的态度是支持且较为理性，并非主张学生完全取代成年人。

keypoints.title: 提取整合关键信息
keypoints.body: 从语篇中筛选能够表现主题、回答问题或支撑结论的必要信息，按时间、因果、对比等关系进行梳理，并用简洁、连贯的语言合并表达。

keypoints.title: 筛选并组织信息
keypoints.body: 先明确题目要求，再定位相关段落和关键词；区分主要信息与例子、细节，理清信息之间的关系，最后用自己的话完整概括，避免遗漏要点或机械拼接原文。

exercises.stem:
Read the passage and choose the best summary of how the class reduced food waste.

Every Friday, our class threw away two large bags of unfinished food. Ms. Green asked us to find out why instead of simply telling us to eat more. For one week, three students weighed the leftovers and wrote down what was thrown away. They found that many students took more than they could finish, while some did not like certain vegetables. The class then introduced smaller first servings and a box for unopened fruit. Students could take more food later, and the unopened fruit was saved for the next day. After four weeks, the class threw away only one small bag each Friday. We also learned to choose food more carefully. The project showed us that measuring a problem and changing daily habits can make a difference.

choices.label: A
choices.text: The class measured the causes of waste, changed serving and storage habits, and greatly reduced the amount of food thrown away.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The teacher forced students to eat all the vegetables they disliked.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The class stopped eating lunch and therefore produced less waste.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The students weighed food for the whole school but made no changes afterward.

exercises.explanation: 选项A整合了文章的关键信息：先称量并记录剩余食物、找出浪费原因，再采用少量先取和保存未开封水果等办法，最后食物浪费由两大袋降为一小袋。其他选项要么与原文不符，要么只涉及片面信息。

keypoints.title: 事实与观点的含义
keypoints.body: 事实是能够通过文本证据或可靠资料核验的陈述；观点是说话者或作者对人、事、现象作出的判断、评价、态度或推测，通常带有主观性。

keypoints.title: 依据证据辨析
keypoints.body: 先看陈述能否被客观验证，再关注“认为、应该、可能”等表达及褒贬评价词。可核验的内容通常属于事实，表达立场、评价或推测的内容通常属于观点；有证据支持的观点仍可能是观点。

exercises.stem:
Read the passage and choose the sentence that expresses an opinion.

Greenhill Library has served our town for six years. It opened in 2020. It has 12,000 books and four computers. Last Saturday, 85 students joined a reading activity there. Greenhill Library is the most welcoming place in town.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Greenhill Library has served our town for six years.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It opened in 2020.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It has 12,000 books and four computers.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Greenhill Library is the most welcoming place in town.

exercises.explanation: D中的“the most welcoming”是带有主观评价的表达，体现了说话者的看法，属于观点。A、B、C分别说明服务年限、开馆时间和图书及电脑数量，原则上都可以通过记录或观察核验，属于事实。

keypoints.title: 主旨要义的含义
keypoints.body: 主旨要义是语篇围绕某一主题所表达的核心内容，包括作者重点说明或讨论的问题，以及可能传达的目的、态度或启示。

keypoints.title: 提炼核心内容
keypoints.body: 先确定语篇主题，再找各段反复出现或统摄全文的信息，结合标题、开头、结尾和段落关系进行概括。用简洁完整的句子说明“写了什么以及要表达什么”，不要只罗列细节。

exercises.stem:
Read the passage and choose the best main idea.

At Green Hill Middle School, many students had old books at home, but the school library could not buy new ones often. Last spring, the student council placed a small book cart in each classroom. Students could take a book, write a short recommendation on a card, and bring the book back or exchange it. Teachers helped check the carts, but students decided which books to add. At first, only a few students used them. Soon, students began talking about the stories during breaks, and more families donated books. By the end of term, the carts were in busy places such as the cafeteria and the sports hall. The project cost little money, but it gave students an easy way to find and share books.

What is the passage mainly about?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The school library replaced all its books with classroom books.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A student-led book-sharing project made reading easier and more popular at school.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Students had to write book recommendations before every class.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Families bought expensive books for the school library.

exercises.explanation: 文章先介绍学生发起图书车项目，接着说明借阅、交流和捐书等变化，最后指出项目花费少却让学生更容易找到并分享图书。因此全文主旨是学生主导的共享图书项目促进了校园阅读，B概括了主要内容及其作用。

keypoints.title: 隐含意义的含义
keypoints.body: 隐含意义是语篇没有直接说出，却能依据字面信息、上下文关系、语气和情境推导出的意思、态度或结论。

keypoints.title: 结合线索推断
keypoints.body: 先定位相关语句，再联系前后文、因果转折、人物行为和语气等线索进行推理；所得结论应有文本依据、与全文一致，并选择解释力最强而非仅凭个人经验的答案。

exercises.stem:
Read the passage and answer the question.

On Thursday, Amir had to give a science presentation. Before class, he discovered that the last page of his poster had come loose. He searched his bag, but there was no tape. Lena was on her way to piano practice, yet she stopped. She found tape in the art room, helped Amir fix the page, and checked the poster with him. When Amir said, 'You may be late because of me,' Lena only smiled and said, 'A good presentation needs all its pages.' She then hurried away.

What does Lena's response and action most likely show?

choices.label: A
choices.text: She cares only about getting a high grade.

choices.label: B
choices.text: She is willing to help someone even when it may be inconvenient for her.

choices.label: C
choices.text: She believes Amir cannot give a presentation by himself.

choices.label: D
choices.text: She does not really want to go to piano practice.

exercises.explanation: 文中说明Lena正赶去练琴，却停下来找胶带、修海报，之后还匆忙离开。她的话表面上是在说明海报需要完整，结合她的行为可推断出她愿意牺牲自己的时间帮助Amir，B最符合全文线索。

keypoints.title: 语篇整体意义的含义
keypoints.body: 语篇整体意义是对全文主题、主要内容、结构关系以及作者意图或态度的综合理解，不等同于某一句话或某个局部细节的含义。

keypoints.title: 整合全文信息
keypoints.body: 通读全文，先把握主题，再梳理各部分的内容和作用，找出关键信息之间的联系，最后综合概括全文表达的中心意思及作者立场，避免只依据孤立语句作答。

exercises.stem:
Read the passage and choose the statement that best expresses its overall meaning.

Last year, students at Riverbank Middle School often complained that lunchtime was too noisy. Some liked talking with friends, but others wanted to read, finish homework, or simply have a quiet break. Nia noticed that these students usually ate quickly in a corner of the library, even though the library was not officially open at lunch. She suggested a 'quiet lunch' twice a week. During a one-month trial, students could eat in a library room, speak softly, and leave the tables clean. At first, a few students worried that the new space would make friends less close. However, many students used it, and some of them later joined their friends outside after lunch. The school kept the quiet lunch and also asked students for other ideas. The experience showed that giving people different ways to spend a break can help more students feel comfortable at school.

choices.label: A
choices.text: The school solved its lunchtime problem by stopping students from talking.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Nia and the school created a quiet lunch option, showing that respecting different needs can make school more welcoming.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Students should spend lunchtime doing homework instead of talking with friends.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The library became the most popular place in the school because it opened all day.

exercises.explanation: 全文按“午餐问题—Nia提出方案—试行效果—学校保留方案—得到启示”的顺序展开。文章既介绍了安静午餐的做法和结果，也表达了满足不同需要能让更多学生感到舒适、包容的观点，因此B最能概括全文的主题、内容和作者态度。

keypoints.title: 按意义单位理解语篇
keypoints.body: 按意群阅读是把连续的词按照短语、分句或完整意义单位进行理解，而不是逐词停顿翻译，从而更快把握句子和语篇信息。

keypoints.title: 分组阅读并整合信息
keypoints.body: 阅读时依据语法结构、标点和意义关系划分意群，视线逐组移动；先理解每个意群，再联系前后意群，形成完整句意。

exercises.stem:
读下面句子。为了按意群阅读，哪一种分组最恰当？（用“/”表示意群之间的停顿。）
After finishing her homework, Lily went to the library to borrow a book about space.

choices.label: A
choices.text: After finishing her homework, / Lily went to the library / to borrow a book about space.

choices.label: B
choices.text: After / finishing her / homework, Lily / went to the library to / borrow a book about space.

choices.label: C
choices.text: After finishing / her homework, Lily went / to the library to borrow / a book about space.

choices.label: D
choices.text: After finishing her homework Lily / went to / the library / to borrow a book / about space.

exercises.explanation: A按照语法结构和意义关系划分了三个意群：时间状语“After finishing her homework”、主句“Lily went to the library”和目的状语“to borrow a book about space”。这样可以按短语整体理解，避免逐词停顿。

keypoints.title: 借助语境推测词义
keypoints.body: 根据生词所在句子、前后文、语篇主题及逻辑关系，推断其在当前语境中的大致意义，而不必立即查词典。

keypoints.title: 寻找语境线索验证
keypoints.body: 先判断生词的词性，再寻找定义、举例、同义或反义、因果和转折等线索，提出词义后代入原句，检查是否通顺、合乎语境。

exercises.stem:
阅读短文，猜测画线词在语境中的大致意思。
At first, Nina was reluctant to join the school play. She was afraid of speaking in front of many people. After her friends encouraged her, however, she agreed to try.

The word “reluctant” most likely means ______.

choices.label: A
choices.text: unwilling or not ready to do something

choices.label: B
choices.text: very excited about doing something

choices.label: C
choices.text: certain that something will be easy

choices.label: D
choices.text: unable to understand something

exercises.explanation: “reluctant”在句中作形容词。后文说Nina害怕在许多人面前讲话，后来在朋友鼓励后才同意尝试，说明她起初不愿意或不太愿意参加演出，因此选A。

keypoints.title: 利用词的构成推断
keypoints.body: 根据词根、前缀、后缀或合成词各部分的已知意义，结合词性变化，推断生词的基本意义和可能用法。

keypoints.title: 拆分词形再合并
keypoints.body: 先识别熟悉的词根和词缀，判断它们对词义、词性所起的作用；再将各部分意义合并，并结合句子语境进行核对。

exercises.stem:
根据构词法和句意，猜测生词“reusable”的意思。
The instructions say this bottle is reusable: after washing it, you can use it again and again.

choices.label: A
choices.text: 能够再次使用的

choices.label: B
choices.text: 只能使用一次的

choices.label: C
choices.text: 很难清洗的

choices.label: D
choices.text: 由纸制成的

exercises.explanation: “reusable”可以拆分为“re-”和“use”以及后缀“-able”。“re-”表示“再、又”，“use”表示“使用”，“-able”表示“能够……的”，合起来表示“能够再次使用的”。句中“use it again and again”也验证了这一含义。

keypoints.title: 阅读前后的合理预想
keypoints.body: 预测是在正式获取完整信息前，利用标题、图片、关键词、已有知识和上下文线索，对语篇内容、结构或后文信息作出合理预想。

keypoints.title: 提出假设并及时修正
keypoints.body: 阅读前根据显性线索提出初步预测，阅读中用新获得的信息检验；若发现不一致，应调整预测，使其始终以语篇证据为依据。

exercises.stem:
阅读下面的标题、开头和后文：
标题：A Surprise at the Bus Stop
开头：On Monday morning, Leo saw a large covered box beside a bus-stop bench. A note said, “Please do not open it. It needs a quiet place.” He heard a soft rustling sound inside. Before reading further, he guessed that an animal was in the box。后来他读到：“Leo’s sister came running. ‘The baby plants are safe in this box. We are taking them to school for the science show,’ she said.”
根据“提出预测—用新信息检验—及时修正”的阅读策略，Leo应怎样处理原来的预测？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 坚持认为箱子里是动物，因为最初的预测不能改变。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 根据后文的直接信息修正预测，认为箱子里是幼苗。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 只根据标题判断箱子里是什么，不再阅读后文。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 选择听起来最有趣的猜测，不必考虑语篇证据。

exercises.explanation: 预测应建立在已有线索上，但不是固定不变的。后文明确说箱子里是幼苗，因此应依据新证据修正原来“箱子里有动物”的预测。

keypoints.title: 指代关系的含义
keypoints.body: 指代关系是指代词或其他指代语在语篇中所指向的人、事物、时间、地点或动作。理解时要根据上下文确定其具体所指，保证句意和篇章衔接准确。

keypoints.title: 确定指代对象
keypoints.body: 先找出指代语，再回看前文相关名词或内容；结合语法、单复数、人称、语义和逻辑关系逐一排除不合适的对象，最后将候选对象代回原句检验。

exercises.stem:
Read the passage:
“Before the English test, Lucy bought a small dictionary. She put it in her schoolbag and used it to check the meaning of two words.”
In the sentence “She put it in her schoolbag”, what does “it” refer to?

choices.label: A
choices.text: the small dictionary

choices.label: B
choices.text: the schoolbag

choices.label: C
choices.text: the English test

choices.label: D
choices.text: two words

exercises.explanation: 先回看前文，it前最相关的名词是the small dictionary。it为单数，且“把字典放进书包并用它查词”符合语义；schoolbag是放置的地点和容器，不是it所指对象。

keypoints.title: 略读与扫读
keypoints.body: 略读是快速浏览标题、段首段尾和关键词，掌握语篇大意与结构；扫读是带着具体问题快速寻找人名、数字、时间、地点或相关句子。二者都不要求逐词阅读。

keypoints.title: 按目的选择策略
keypoints.body: 需要了解主旨或结构时采用略读，先看标题和段落要点；需要查找特定信息时采用扫读，明确关键词后快速定位，再精读相关语句核对答案。

exercises.stem:
Read the notice:
“School Reading Day
Saturday, May 18
Place: school library
At 9:30, Mr. Wang will talk about choosing books. At 11:00, students can exchange books. The story-reading time begins at 1:30 p.m. Registration closes on May 10.”
You only need to know when the story-reading begins. Which reading method is most suitable?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use skimming: read the title and the main parts to understand the general idea.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use scanning: look for the keyword “story-reading” or a time, then read the nearby sentence.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Read every word slowly from the beginning to the end.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Guess the time from the date without looking for relevant information.

exercises.explanation: 题目要求查找具体时间，属于特定信息，应采用扫读。先用“story-reading”等关键词快速定位，再阅读附近句子核对，得到1:30 p.m.；略读主要用于了解主旨和结构。

keypoints.title: 累计阅读量要求
keypoints.body: 课外阅读量要求是学习者在规定阶段之外，通过持续阅读英语材料累计接触的词数标准。相关要求包括累计达到4万词以上或10万词以上，具体对应的学段以课程要求为准。

keypoints.title: 持续记录阅读量
keypoints.body: 根据目标总词数制订分阶段计划，选择适合水平的英语读物，读后记录书名、完成日期和词数，定期汇总并调整进度，确保累计量达到相应要求。

exercises.stem: 某同学所在学段的课程要求为课外英语累计阅读量达到4万词以上。他准备从9月开始完成目标。下列计划最符合“持续记录阅读量”的做法是（ ）。

choices.label: A
choices.text: 按月设定目标，选择适合自己水平的读物；每读完一本，记录书名、完成日期和词数，每月汇总并根据进度调整。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 只在学期末凭印象估计读过多少页，不记录书名和日期。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 为了尽快达标，只读远高于自己水平的材料，并把每页按固定词数估算，不核对。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 只记录每天的阅读时间，因为阅读时间可以直接替代累计词数。

exercises.explanation: 课外阅读量按接触的词数累计，完成计划需要选择适合水平的材料，并记录书名、完成日期和词数，定期汇总后及时调整进度。A完整体现了这些要求；B、D缺少词数记录，C的材料难度和估算方法都不恰当。

keypoints.title: 名人传记的内容
keypoints.body: 名人传记是以真实的知名人物为对象，介绍其成长经历、重要事件、主要成就及社会影响的阅读材料。阅读时应关注人物经历的时间顺序、因果关系和个性特点。

keypoints.title: 读懂人物经历
keypoints.body: 先了解传记对象和文章主线，再按时间整理关键事件，分析经历与成就之间的联系；结合具体事实概括人物品质，区分传记中的事实叙述与评价性内容。

exercises.stem: 阅读下面的传记片段，选择最能说明人物经历与成就之间联系的一项。\n\nLouis Braille was born in France in 1809. When he was three, an accident in his father’s workshop injured his eyes, and he later lost his sight. As a student, he wanted blind people to read more easily. He studied a system of raised dots used by soldiers and changed it into a simpler system with six dots. In 1824, when he was fifteen, he finished the first version of the system. It became known as Braille and helped many blind people read and write. His careful work and concern for others made a lasting difference.

choices.label: A
choices.text: After losing his sight, Braille wanted to help blind readers; by studying and improving an existing raised-dot system, he created Braille.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Braille first created a reading system and then became blind, so he tested the system on himself.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Braille copied the soldiers’ system without making any changes, and his father taught it to him.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Braille’s main achievement came from traveling to many countries and giving public speeches.

exercises.explanation: 文章先写Braille失明，接着写他希望帮助盲人阅读，然后说明他研究并改进已有的凸点系统，最终形成盲文，体现了经历、努力与成就之间的因果联系。B、C、D均与文中事实不符。

keypoints.title: 报刊文章的阅读对象
keypoints.body: 阅读以新闻、报道、评论等为主的报刊文本，借助标题、导语、段落和语境理解主要事实、观点及作者态度，并关注信息来源和时效性。

keypoints.title: 分层获取报刊信息
keypoints.body: 先浏览标题、图片和版面，预测文章主题；再快速阅读，抓住时间、地点、人物、事件等关键信息；最后细读相关段落，判断事实与观点，结合上下文推测生词含义。

exercises.stem:
阅读下面的报刊文章，选择其中可以直接确认的两项信息（不要把个人评价当成客观事实）。

School Garden Gives Students a New Place to Learn

Riverside, Oct. 8—Riverside Middle School opened a small garden on Tuesday to give students a place to learn about plants. The garden has 12 planting beds. According to science teacher Ms. Lee, 80 students signed up for weekly work in the garden. They will grow tomatoes and beans, and the school plans to use some vegetables in cooking classes. Student Chen said, “It is the best place in school.” The next work day is Oct. 15. The school hopes the project will help students care more about nature.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Riverside Middle School opened the garden on Tuesday.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The garden has 12 planting beds.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The garden is the best place in the school for every student.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The project has already made every student care more about nature.

exercises.explanation: A和B分别由导语和正文直接提供，是可核实的报道事实。C只是学生Chen的个人评价，不能代表所有学生；D把学校的希望误认为已经发生的结果，且“每个学生”没有文章依据。

keypoints.title: 短篇小说的阅读对象
keypoints.body: 短篇小说是篇幅较短、人物和情节相对集中的虚构叙事作品，通常通过环境、冲突、人物行为和结局表现主题或情感。

keypoints.title: 梳理小说内容
keypoints.body: 阅读时先确定人物、时间、地点和事件，再按情节发展找出冲突、转折与结局；结合人物语言、行动和环境描写，推断人物特点及作品主题。

exercises.stem:
Read the short story and choose the best lesson.

Every Friday, Ben stayed after school to water the flowers outside the library. One windy afternoon, he noticed that the library door was still open, but everyone had gone home. Inside, a small dog was shaking under a table. Ben wanted to leave because dark clouds were gathering. Then a poster near the door fell; behind it was a phone number. He called it. While waiting, he gave the dog some water and used his coat to keep it warm. A woman soon arrived and hugged the dog. She thanked Ben, but Ben only smiled and went home in the rain. The next Friday, the dog was sitting by the library, waiting for him.

What is the best lesson of the story?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A kind and responsible action can help others and build trust.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Students should never help animals after school.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Bad weather always makes people miss their homes.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A library is the best place to keep a dog.

exercises.explanation: 故事中的人物是Ben，地点是图书馆，主要冲突是他在天要下雨时选择离开还是帮助受困的小狗。他通过寻找电话号码、打电话、给小狗水并用外套保暖解决了问题，结尾小狗在图书馆等他，说明善意和负责的行为不仅能帮助别人，也能建立信任。

keypoints.title: 询问与回应的含义
keypoints.body: 有效询问与恰当回应，是根据交际目的和情境提出清楚、礼貌、具体的问题，并作出准确、相关的回答或追问，使双方顺利交换信息。

keypoints.title: 完成问答交流
keypoints.body: 询问前明确想了解的信息，选择合适的疑问形式和礼貌表达；回应时先直接回答，再按需要补充原因或细节；没有听清时可礼貌请求重复或澄清。

exercises.stem: At school, you want to join the English club. You need to know the meeting time and place. Which dialogue shows an effective, polite question and an appropriate response?

choices.label: A
choices.text:
—Excuse me, could you tell me when and where the English club meets?
—It meets at 4:30 p.m. every Thursday in Room 203.

choices.label: B
choices.text:
—Tell me about the English club.
—It is interesting.

choices.label: C
choices.text:
—Could you tell me when and where the English club meets?
—I like English very much.

choices.label: D
choices.text:
—When and where does the English club meet?
—Why do you want to join?

exercises.explanation: A中的问题使用了礼貌表达“Excuse me”和“could you”，并且具体询问时间和地点；回答直接给出了时间、星期和教室，信息准确、相关且完整。B的问题和回答都不具体，C没有回答所问内容，D也没有提供所需信息。

keypoints.title: 持续交谈的含义
keypoints.body: 发起并维持交谈，是主动用问候、提问或评论开启话题，并通过回应、追问、补充和适时转换话题，使交流自然、连续地进行。

keypoints.title: 让交谈自然延续
keypoints.body: 可从共同情境、兴趣或经历切入；认真回应对方内容，使用追问、补充和表示兴趣的表达；话题暂时结束时，礼貌总结或自然引出相关新话题。

exercises.stem: During break, you meet a new classmate, Sam, who is holding a basketball. Which exchange best starts a conversation and keeps it going naturally?

choices.label: A
choices.text:
You: Hi, I’m Wei. I noticed your basketball. Do you play for the school team?
Sam: Yes. We practise on Tuesdays.
You: Nice! What position do you play?
Sam: Guard.
You: That sounds interesting. Do you have a game this week?
Sam: Yes, on Friday. Would you like to watch?
You: Sure. Where is it?

choices.label: B
choices.text:
You: Hi. What is your name?
Sam: Sam.
You: OK. Bye.

choices.label: C
choices.text:
You: Give me your basketball.
Sam: No.
You: You are not friendly.

choices.label: D
choices.text:
You: Do you play basketball?
Sam: Yes.
You: What is your favorite food?
Sam: Noodles.

exercises.explanation: A先用问候和共同情境开启话题，再围绕篮球进行回应和连续追问，表达兴趣并自然获得更多信息，因此交流连贯。B很快结束交谈，C表达不礼貌，D在没有回应对方篮球信息的情况下突然转换到食物话题。

keypoints.title: 参与讨论的含义
keypoints.body: 参与讨论是在共同话题下，先理解他人观点，再用恰当语言表达自己的看法、提问、回应或补充，围绕交流目标与他人互动。

keypoints.title: 参与讨论的方法
keypoints.body: 先用简短句引出或确认话题；发言时说明观点并给出理由或例子；用礼貌方式询问；听完后及时回应或补充，避免偏离主题。

exercises.stem: 小组正在讨论“How can we make our school greener?” Ben 说：“We should use more paper posters because everyone can see them.”你认为电子通知更好。请用英语作出3—4句回应：先礼貌回应Ben的观点，再表达自己的看法并说明一个理由或举例，最后提出一个与话题相关的礼貌问题或补充建议。
exercises.answer: I see your point, Ben. However, I think digital notices are better because they save paper. For example, we can put them on the school website. Could we try digital notices for one month?
exercises.explanation: 答案先用“I see your point”表明理解并礼貌回应他人观点；接着用“However”转入自己的看法，并用“because”说明理由、用例子补充；最后用“Could we...?”提出相关且礼貌的问题。全程围绕校园环保这一话题，没有偏离主题。表达不必与示例完全相同，但应包含理解或回应、观点、理由或例子，以及提问或补充中的相应内容。

keypoints.title: 语调重音的作用
keypoints.body: 语调是说话时声音高低的变化，重音是对词或句中关键信息加以突出。二者配合可表达疑问、强调、对比等意义，使重点更清楚。

keypoints.title: 突出重点的做法
keypoints.body: 先确定想让听者关注的信息，再把关键词读得更清晰、稍响或稍长，并用合适的升降调配合语意；不要平均重读每个词，也不要只靠提高音量。

exercises.stem: 情境：同学问：“Did Jack bring the science book?”实际是Lucy带来的，你想让同学特别注意“Lucy”。请写出你会说的英文句子，用大写字母标出重读词，并用“↓”或“↑”标出句末语调；再用一句中文说明这样处理的作用。
exercises.answer:
No, LUCY brought the science book. ↓
说明：重读LUCY可以突出人物的对比，完整的陈述句使用降调，能清楚地表达纠正和强调。
exercises.explanation: “LUCY”是需要听者特别关注的关键信息，应读得更清晰、稍响或稍长，以区别于问题中的Jack。回答是一个完整的陈述句，句末使用降调更符合陈述和纠正的语意。不能把每个词都平均重读，也不能只靠提高音量来突出重点。

keypoints.title: 口头概括的含义
keypoints.body: 口头概括语篇内容，是在理解全文后，用自己的话简明、有条理地说出主题和主要信息，保留关键人物、事件、原因或结果，不逐句背诵，也不添加原文没有的内容。

keypoints.title: 概括语篇的方法
keypoints.body: 先判断主题，再按内容线索筛选关键信息；用开头概述主题，随后按时间、因果或总分顺序组织，最后检查表达是否完整、连贯、简洁。

exercises.stem: 阅读下面的短文，然后用英语口头概括，限2—3句。概括时要说出主题、活动地点发生变化的原因和最后的结果；请用自己的话表达，不要逐句背诵，也不要添加原文没有的信息。\n\nLast Saturday, our class planned a picnic in the park. In the morning, heavy rain began, so the teacher moved the activity to the school hall. The students shared the food, played word games and told stories there. Although the place changed, everyone had a good time.
exercises.answer: The passage is about a class picnic that had to be moved because of heavy rain. The students shared food and played games in the school hall, and they still had a good time.
exercises.explanation: 示例先概述语篇主题，即班级野餐；随后说明因下大雨，活动从公园改到学校礼堂；最后概括学生在礼堂开展活动并且玩得很开心这一结果。答案保留了主要事件、原因和结果，按事情发展顺序组织，语言简洁，没有逐句复述或添加原文没有的信息。

keypoints.title: 朗读与复述的含义
keypoints.body: 朗读是依据文字材料，准确、流利并有节奏地读出内容；复述是在理解后脱离原文或少看原文，按主要情节和逻辑用自己的话重新讲述。

keypoints.title: 朗读复述的方法
keypoints.body: 朗读前划分意群并标出停顿、重音和语气，朗读时保持准确流利。复述前列出人物、事件、顺序和结果等提纲，再用连接词连贯讲述，不机械逐句翻译。

exercises.stem: 请完成两个部分。阅读下面短文：On Saturday morning, Ben went to the park with his little sister. They saw a baby bird under a tree. Ben carefully put it back into the nest, and the children waited quietly. Soon, the mother bird flew back. The children smiled and left.（1）朗读前，用 / 标出意群停顿，用 // 标出句间较长停顿，并标出至少5个需要重读的关键词；朗读时保持平静、关切的语气，陈述句末用自然降调。（2）朗读后遮住原文，先写出人物、事件、顺序和结果四项提纲，再用自己的英语复述4—5句。
exercises.answer: 示例：朗读标注：On [SATURDAY] morning, / Ben went to the [PARK] with his little [SISTER]. // They saw a [BABY BIRD] under a [TREE]. // Ben [CAREFULLY] put it back into the [NEST], / and the children waited [QUIETLY]. // Soon, the [MOTHER BIRD] flew back. // The children [SMILED] and [LEFT].语气：平静、关切；陈述句末降调。提纲：Ben and his sister—find a baby bird—return it to the nest and wait—mother bird returns, children leave。复述示例：One Saturday, Ben and his sister found a baby bird in the park. Ben put it back in its nest, and they waited quietly. When its mother came back, the children smiled and went away.
exercises.explanation: 题目要求先划分意群、安排停顿和重音，再进行准确流利的朗读；复述时要从人物、事件、顺序和结果提取要点。示例复述没有逐句翻译原文，而是用自己的话完整讲出发现小鸟、放回鸟巢、等待、鸟妈妈回来和孩子离开等关键情节。重音词可有合理调整，但应突出意义重点。

keypoints.title: 角色扮演的含义
keypoints.body: 角色扮演是根据故事、对话或情境，进入特定人物身份，用合适的语气、语调和动作表现人物，并连贯呈现相关内容的口头表达活动。

keypoints.title: 角色扮演的步骤
keypoints.body: 先读懂情节和人物关系，再确定人物的语言、语气和动作；按情节顺序进行对话，注意听清对方并及时回应，避免只背台词而忽略内容和人物特点。

exercises.stem: 两人一组完成英语角色扮演。情境：上课前，新生 Emma 在教学楼里找不到203教室，显得着急；学生志愿者 Leo 主动帮助她。Emma 要说明自己是新生并询问地点；Leo 要确认她要找的教室，给出上二楼、左转、音乐教室旁的路线，并检查 Emma 是否明白；Emma 要复述或确认路线并表示感谢。表演中至少加入一个符合身份的动作和两种语气：Emma 着急，Leo 友善耐心。若对方表示没听懂，须换一种说法及时回应。不要照读预设台词，要按情节自然对话。
exercises.answer: 示例：Emma（looking around, worried）：Excuse me, I’m new here. Could you help me find Room 203? Leo（smiling）：Sure. Are you looking for the English classroom? Emma：Yes. I don’t know this building. Leo：Go up to the second floor and turn left. Room 203 is next to the music room. Emma：So I go upstairs, turn left, and look beside the music room, right? Leo：Exactly. Emma：Thank you for your help. Leo：You’re welcome. Let’s go.
exercises.explanation: 示例先通过动作和语气表现人物身份与状态，再按照求助、确认、指路、复述确认、感谢的情节顺序展开对话。Emma 对 Leo 的信息作了复述，说明她在听并作出回应；Leo 的表达友善耐心。答案具有开放性，只要人物关系、语言功能、动作语气和回应符合情境即可。

keypoints.title: 观点表达的含义
keypoints.body: 表达个人观点并说明理由，是先明确说出自己对某一问题的看法，再用事实、经验、道理或例子作有条理的解释，使观点清楚、理由相关。

keypoints.title: 观点表达的结构
keypoints.body: 可按“观点—理由—例证或说明—总结”组织语言。先直接表明看法，再说明理由并提供具体依据，最后简要重申观点；理由应围绕观点，避免重复或偏题。

exercises.stem: 学校正在讨论：每周是否应该安排一个无作业晚。请用英语发表看法，写或说60—80词。必须按观点—理由—例证或说明—总结组织：开头明确同意或不同意；给出至少两个围绕观点的理由；用一个具体例子或个人经历说明其中一个理由；最后重申观点。不要只列词语，也不要重复同一理由。
exercises.answer: 示例：I agree that our school should have one homework-free evening every week. First, a short break helps students relax and return to study with more energy. Second, we can spend useful time with our families or do exercise. For example, after I play basketball on Friday evening, I sleep better and finish my work faster the next day. Therefore, one homework-free evening can make school life healthier and learning more effective.
exercises.explanation: 示例首句明确表达赞成观点；First 和 Second 引出两个相关理由；For example 提供了打篮球后的具体经历；Therefore 在结尾重申安排无作业晚的好处。理由都围绕身心放松和提高学习状态展开，没有偏题或机械重复。持相反观点也可以，只要观点清楚、理由相关、例证具体并有总结。

keypoints.title: 主题演讲的含义
keypoints.body: 主题演讲是围绕一个明确主题，面向听众进行较完整、连贯的口头表达，旨在传递信息、阐明观点或引发思考。

keypoints.title: 主题演讲的准备
keypoints.body: 先明确主题、听众和表达目的，筛选相关材料并列出提纲；演讲时按开头、主体、结尾展开，做到声音清楚、语速适当、重点突出，并根据听众反应调整表达。

exercises.stem: 学校举行英语主题演讲活动。你的主题是“How to Save Water”，听众是同学，目的是介绍节水方法并倡议大家行动。下列哪种准备和演讲方式最合适？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 搜集许多与节水无关的笑话，演讲时快速讲完，不必考虑同学是否听懂。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 搜集几条简单事实和实例，列出提纲：开头引出主题，主体介绍方法，结尾总结并发出倡议；演讲时声音清楚、语速适当，突出重点，并根据同学的反应作必要调整。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 只背诵一段材料，不必明确演讲目的；演讲时从一个细节开始，想到哪里说到哪里。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 准备很多复杂词汇和长句，演讲时一直低头朗读，不必安排开头、主体和结尾。

exercises.explanation: 主题演讲应围绕明确主题，考虑听众和表达目的，筛选相关材料并列出提纲，按开头、主体、结尾连贯表达。演讲时还要做到声音清楚、语速适当、重点突出，并关注听众反应。B完整符合这些要求。

keypoints.title: 每周时长要求
keypoints.body: 视听活动时长要求是：课外每周用于收听或观看主题相关、语速较慢的广播、电视或网络节目的时间累计不少于30分钟。

keypoints.title: 安排视听活动
keypoints.body: 可将每周30分钟分成若干次完成，选择主题相关且语速较慢的节目；每次活动后尝试说出主题和主要信息，并记录日期与时长，按周检查是否达标。

exercises.stem: 你要安排一周的课外英语视听活动。下列哪项安排最符合“每周累计不少于30分钟”的要求？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 周一、周三、周五各观看10分钟与英语学习无关且语速很快的节目，不记录活动情况。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 周二和周六各观看15分钟主题相关、语速较慢的英语节目；每次活动后说出主题和主要信息，并记录日期和时长。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 周日观看20分钟主题相关、语速较慢的英语节目，活动后记录日期，但不再安排其他时间。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 周一观看30分钟主题相关的英语节目，但节目语速很快，也不尝试说出主题和主要信息。

exercises.explanation: B将活动分成两次，每次15分钟，累计30分钟；节目主题相关、语速较慢，并在活动后概括主题和主要信息、记录日期与时长，符合视听活动的时长和安排要求。A、C时长或内容不合要求，D节目语速不合适且缺少活动后的整理。

keypoints.title: 从广播电视中获取主要信息
keypoints.body: 观看主题相关、语速较慢的广播电视节目时，识别节目主题，理解整体内容，并提取人物、事件、时间、地点等主要信息。

keypoints.title: 分层观看抓住要点
keypoints.body: 先看节目名称、画面或导语，预测主题；观看时重点关注反复出现的词语和关键信息；结束后用简短的话概括主题和主要内容。

exercises.stem: 你观看一则语速较慢的英语电视报道，节目名称是“A Clean River Day”。导语说：“Last Sunday morning, students from No. 2 Middle School joined volunteers at Green River in Lakeside Town. From 8:30 to 10:30, they picked up rubbish and put it into bags.”下列哪项最准确地概括了节目内容？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 上周日早晨，第二中学的学生和志愿者在湖滨镇的绿河边捡拾垃圾，活动时间是8:30到10:30。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 上周一下午，老师带领学生在校园里种树，活动持续两个小时。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 第二中学的学生在绿河边举行游泳比赛，并在上午10:30结束。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 志愿者在另一个城镇修建了一座桥，节目主要介绍桥梁的建造过程。

exercises.explanation: 先根据节目名称和导语确定主题是清洁河流，再提取人物（第二中学学生和志愿者）、事件（捡拾垃圾）、时间（上周日8:30至10:30）和地点（湖滨镇绿河）。A完整准确地概括了主要信息。

keypoints.title: 理解网络节目的大意
keypoints.body: 观看主题相关、语速较慢的网络节目时，抓住话题和核心内容，理解节目的整体意思，不必拘泥于每个单词或句子的逐字翻译。

keypoints.title: 借助线索概括内容
keypoints.body: 先利用标题、简介和画面预测内容，再根据开头、重复出现的关键词和结尾确认主题；观看后回答“讲什么、有哪些主要信息”，检验是否理解大意。

exercises.stem: 观看下面这段原创英语网络节目片段（语速较慢）。标题：A Bean's Four-Week Journey；简介：Students show what happens in their school garden.画面线索：开头是空花盆，随后出现豆种、发芽和长叶，结尾学生把摘下的豆子放进午餐盘。你听到的关键词和句子包括“school garden”“plant beans”“water them every morning”“pick them for lunch”。What is the program mainly about?

choices.label: A
choices.text: How students cook a big lunch.

choices.label: B
choices.text: How students grow beans at school and use them for lunch.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Why the school is closed for four weeks.

choices.label: D
choices.text: How students choose a new school uniform.

exercises.explanation: 标题、简介、画面变化以及反复出现的关键词都指向同一主题：学生在学校花园种植豆子，并把豆子用于午餐。理解大意时抓住这些整体线索即可，不需要逐词翻译。

keypoints.title: 综合文字与视觉信息
keypoints.body: 整合文字、图表、图片、影像等不同形式的信息，比较它们表达的内容，发现互相补充或印证的关系，从而形成完整理解。

keypoints.title: 分看信息再相互印证
keypoints.body: 先分别提取文字和非文字信息的要点，再判断它们是否对应、补充或强调；遇到不一致时结合标题、语境和数据核对，最后用完整语句概括共同信息。

exercises.stem: 请看一个原创英语海报的文字和画面。文字部分：GREEN SCHOOL DAY；Saturday, May 18；9:00–11:00 a.m.；Meet at the school gate.；Bring gloves and a water bottle. Work in small groups.画面部分：海报中有三组学生；一组戴手套把纸和塑料瓶分别放进两个箱子，一组给树苗浇水，另一组在校门旁看着标有“9:00–11:00”的时钟；海报下方画有手套和水瓶图标。Which sentence best combines the information from the words and the picture?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Students will have a two-hour recycling and tree-care activity in groups, and they should bring gloves and a water bottle.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Students will watch a film about water at school from 9 to 11.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Students will plant trees alone after school, and no tools are needed.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Students will sell plastic bottles at the school gate on Sunday.

exercises.explanation: 文字提供了活动时间、集合地点、分组方式和所需物品；图片进一步呈现了分类回收和给树苗浇水，并印证了分组、手套和水瓶等信息。将两类信息合并后，只有A完整准确。

keypoints.title: 读懂并解释图表信息
keypoints.body: 根据图表的标题、项目、单位、图例和数据，理解其中呈现的数量关系、变化趋势或差异，并用语言准确说明图表表达的主要信息。

keypoints.title: 按要素读取图表
keypoints.body: 先确定图表主题和统计范围，再查看横纵项目、单位及图例；随后比较数据、找出最高最低值和变化趋势，最后用“对象＋变化或差异”组织结论。

exercises.stem: Read the chart. It shows how 65 students in Grade 8 travel to school. Chart title: How Students Travel to School. Unit: number of students. Way: Walk | Bike | Bus | Car. Number of students: 12 | 18 | 25 | 10. Which sentence is correct?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Taking the bus is the most common way, while taking a car is the least common.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Walking is more common than taking a bus.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The same number of students walk and ride bikes.

choices.label: D
choices.text: More students take cars than bikes.

exercises.explanation: 先根据标题和单位确定图表统计的是学生上学方式及人数，再比较数据：步行12人、骑车18人、乘公交车25人、乘汽车10人。因此公交车人数最多，汽车人数最少，A正确。

keypoints.title: 图像符号的表达作用
keypoints.body: 图像与符号是多模态语篇中的视觉信息，如图表、地图、标志、图标、颜色和箭头等，能够直接或辅助表达对象、数量、关系、方向、顺序和提示。

keypoints.title: 解读视觉信息
keypoints.body: 先看标题、图例、单位和标注，识别图像中的对象及符号；再关注位置、大小、颜色、箭头等关系，把视觉信息与文字对应，概括其直接信息并推断表达意图。

exercises.stem:
Look at the map titled “Green School Walk”.

Legend: a green arrow = walking route; a yellow circle = water station; a red cross = first-aid box.

Map: Gate → Garden → Hall.
A yellow circle is next to the Hall. A red cross is next to the Garden.

Which statement is correct?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The walking route goes from Hall to Garden to Gate.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Visitors can get water at Hall and find first aid in Garden.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The yellow circle tells visitors to follow the walking route.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The red cross means that Garden is the school exit.

exercises.explanation: 先根据图例识别符号：黄色圆圈表示饮水处，红色十字表示急救箱；再结合符号所在位置，可知 Hall 有饮水处，Garden 有急救箱。绿色箭头表示路线方向，即从 Gate 经过 Garden 到 Hall。

keypoints.title: 视频动画的意义来源
keypoints.body: 视频和动画通过连续画面、人物动作、场景变化、声音、字幕、镜头和剪辑等共同传达信息、情节、情感或观点，意义往往来自多种线索的综合。

keypoints.title: 按视听线索理解
keypoints.body: 观看前了解标题或任务；观看时关注人物、动作、场景、语音、音乐和字幕的变化，理清事件顺序；观看后联系前后情节，概括主要内容并判断表达目的。

exercises.stem:
You watch a 45-second animation titled “A Clean Park”. In scene 1, a boy drops a plastic bottle in a park. The park is quiet and the music is low. In scene 2, a close-up shows a bird near the bottle, and the subtitle says, “Plastic can hurt animals.” In scene 3, the boy and his friends pick up the litter and put it in bins. The music becomes bright, and the subtitle says, “Keep our park clean.”

What is the main purpose of the animation?

choices.label: A
choices.text: To tell a funny story about birds.

choices.label: B
choices.text: To teach people how to make plastic bottles.

choices.label: C
choices.text: To encourage people not to litter and to protect public places.

choices.label: D
choices.text: To report the weather in a park.

exercises.explanation: 动画按“乱扔塑料瓶—动物可能受伤—捡拾垃圾”的顺序展开，字幕直接说明塑料会伤害动物，结尾明亮的音乐和号召性字幕强化了环保态度。因此其主要目的是劝导人们不要乱扔垃圾、保护公共场所。

keypoints.title: 两类文本的功能
keypoints.body: 日记是按时间记录个人经历、见闻、感受或想法的应用文；活动计划是为实现活动目标，对时间、地点、人员、任务、流程和准备事项作出的安排。

keypoints.title: 分别安排写作内容
keypoints.body: 写日记要注明日期，按事情发展记录经过，并写出真实感受；写活动计划要先明确目标，再列出时间、地点、参加者、分工、步骤、物品和注意事项，内容要具体有序。

exercises.stem: Your class will hold a “Reading and Sharing Day” on June 15. Write an activity plan in English in 60–80 words. Include the goal, time, place, participants, jobs, steps, things to prepare, and one note for participants.
exercises.answer:
Reading and Sharing Day Plan
Goal: To share good books and enjoy reading.
Time: June 15, 2:00–4:00 p.m.
Place: Our classroom.
Participants: All students in Class 8.
Jobs: Li Mei welcomes everyone, and Tom takes photos.
Steps: First, we introduce our books. Next, groups share and discuss them. Finally, everyone recommends one book.
